title: ИНТЕРЕСЫ БЕЗОПАСНОСТИ РОССИИ И КИТАЯ В КОНТЕКСТЕ НОВЫХ ДОКТРИНАЛЬНЫХ ДОКУМЕНТОВ США
title_original: ИНТЕРЕСЫ БЕЗОПАСНОСТИ РОССИИ И КИТАЯ В КОНТЕКСТЕ НОВЫХ ДОКТРИНАЛЬНЫХ ДОКУМЕНТОВ США
summary:
Статья посвящена рассмотрению новых подходов адми­ни­страции президента США Д. Трампа к вопросам военной политики госу­дарства, изложенных в основополагающих доктринальных документах — «Стратегии национальной безопасности (СНБ)» и «Стратегии национальной обороны (СНО)» США, опубликованных в конце 2025 и начале 2026 гг. Кроме того, анализируются такие вопросы, как трансфомация места и ро­ли Соединенных Штатов на международной арене, их отношение с другими государствами и военно-политическими союзами. Основное внимание в кон­тексте безопасности уделяется Европейскому и Азиатско-Тихоокеанскому регионам, а также взаимоотношениям США с Россией и Китаем. На фоне продолжающегося украинского кризиса оцениваются возмож­ные направления развития военно-политической обстановки и влияние по­ли­тики руководства Евросоюза, НАТО, США, России и Украины на ее ход   и исход. Анализ этих факторов приводит к выводу о том, что даже в случае за­вершения конфликта на основе договоренностей, достигнутых на российско-американских переговорах в Анкоридже, возможность его возобновления не исключается. Более того — не исключено, при определенных условиях, расширение мас­штабов конфликта с втягиванием в него Северо-Атлантического союза, или отдельных его участников — так называемой коалиции желающих. Преж­де всего, Великобритании, Франции, Германии и некоторых других государств. США, оставаясь «над схваткой», согласно новым доктринальным уста­нов­кам названных выше докумнтов, постепенно будут перекладывать все из­держки конфликта на европейских союзников (что уже происходит), получая дивиденды от поставок им вооружений, боеприпасов, других средств ведения силовой борьбы и военного снаряжения для последующей передачи украин­ской стороне. При этом Д. Трамп и его администрация основные усилия   со­редоточат на сдерживании Китая, предпринимая всевозможные меры с целью «оторвать» от него Россию. Автор приходит к выводу о необходимость интенсификации или/и возоб­новления работы по формированию новой системы безопасности Евразии   с учетом коренных измненений международной обстановки в сфере безопас­ности, что обусловливает актуальность настоящей статьи.
                  The article is devoted to the consideration of new approaches of the administration of the President of the USA D. Trump’s approach to the issues of the state’s military policy outlined in the fundamental doctrinal documents — the National Security Strategy (NSS) and the National Defense Strategy (NSD) of the United States, published in late 2025 and early 2026. The article analyzes issues such as the transformation of the United States’ place and role in the international arena, as well as its relations with other countries and military-political alliances. The focus is on the European and Asia-Pacific regions, as well as the United  States’ relations with Russiaand China. In the context of the ongoing Ukrainian crisis, the article evaluates the possible developments in the military-political situation and the impact of the policies of the European Union, NATO, the United  States, Ukraine, and Russiaon its course and outcome. An analysis of these factors leads to the conclusion that even if the conflict is resolved based on the agreements reached at the Russian-American talks in Anchorage, the possibility of a resumption of the Ukrainian crisis cannot be completely ruled out. Moreover, under certain conditions, the conflict may expand to involve the North Atlantic Alliance or individual members of the so-called “coalition of willing parties,” such as the United Kingdom, France, Germany, and other countries. According to the new doctrinal guidelines outlined in the above-mentioned documents, the United States, while remaining “above the fray,” will gradually shift the costs of the conflict onto its European allies, profiting from the supply of weapons, ammunition, and other military equipment to Ukraine. Meanwhile, Presi­dent Trump and his administration will focus their efforts on containing China, taking various measures to separate Russiafrom China. The author concludes that it is necessary to intensify or resume work on the formation of a new Eurasian security system, taking into account the fundamental changes in the international security environment, which makes this article relevant.

title: ОБ ЭНЕРГЕТИЧЕСКОМ СОТРУДНИЧЕСТВЕ КНР СО СТРАНАМИ БЛИЖНЕГО ВОСТОКА: ПРОБЛЕМЫ И ПЕРСПЕКТИВЫ
title_original: ОБ ЭНЕРГЕТИЧЕСКОМ СОТРУДНИЧЕСТВЕ КНР СО СТРАНАМИ БЛИЖНЕГО ВОСТОКА: ПРОБЛЕМЫ И ПЕРСПЕКТИВЫ
summary:
В статье представлен комплексный анализ развития топлив­но-энергетического сотрудничества между Китайской Народной Республи­кой и государствами Ближнего Востока. В условиях растущей энергетической зависимости КНР, где на импортную нефть приходится более 70% от ее об­щего объема потребления в стране, а доля ближневосточных поставщиков составляет около 50%, данное партнерство приобретает стратегическое зна­чение для глобальной энергетической безопасности. Целью настоящего ис­следования является анализ текущего состояния и перспектив китайско-ближневосточных отношений в энергетической сфере. В статье подробно рассматриваются исторические этапы сотрудничества: от первых контрактов 1990-х гг. до современности, отмеченной развитием Инициативы «Пояс и путь» и глобальным энергопереходом. Особое внима­ние уделяется ключевым партнерам Китая в регионе (Саудовская Аравия, Иран, ОАЭ, Ирак, Катар), анализируются объемы и структура торговли неф­тью и сжиженным природным газом, а также инвестиции китайских корпо­раций (CNPC, Sinopec) в разработку месторождений и инфраструктурные проекты. Также отмечаются основные механизмы экономического взаимо­действия, включая долгосрочные контракты и финансовые инструменты,   и ана­лизируются современные тенденции, связанные с декарбонизацией и развитием «зеленой» и водородной энергетики. Авторы констатируют клю­чевые проблемы партнерства, среди которых: геополитическая нестабиль­ность на Ближнем Востоке, волатильность мировых цен на углеводороды, экологические требования и растущая конкуренция с другими импортерами. В заключение делается вывод о том, что сотрудничество Китая и стран Ближнего Востока не просто поддерживается, но и трансформируется от простой торговли сырой нефтью к многокомпонентной модели. Эта модель включает: 1. разные виды энергии (нефть + газ + ВИЭ + водород), 2. разные технологии (улавливание углерода, атомная энергия) и 3. новые финансовые механизмы (расчеты в юанях). Такая диверсификация — не «очевидная мера предосторожности», а единственный способ сделать стратегическое партнер­ство устойчивым перед лицом геополитических шоков (блокада Ормузского пролива), экологического перехода и волатильности цен.
                  This article presents a comprehensive analysis of fuel and energy co­operation between the People's Republic of China and the Middle East. Given China’s growing energy dependence, with oil imports exceeding 70% of the coun­try’s total consumption and Middle Eastern suppliers accounting for approxi­mately 50%, this partnership is acquiring strategic significance for global energy security. The aim of this paper is to examine the evolution, current status, and prospects of bilateral energy relations. The article examines in detail the historical stages of cooperation: from the first contracts in the 1990s to the current stage, marked by the implementation of the Belt and Road Initiative and the global en­ergy transition. Particular attention is paid to China’s key partners in the region (Saudi Arabia, Iran, the UAE, Iraq, and Qatar), and the volume and structure of oil and liquefied natural gas trade are analyzed, as well as the investment activities of Chinese corporations (CNPC and Sinopec) in field development and infrastructure projects. The article outlines the main mechanisms of interaction, including long-term contracts and financial instruments, and analyzes current trends related to decarbonization and the development of green and hydrogen energy. The work systematizes key partnership challenges: geopolitical instability in the region, hy­drocarbon price volatility, environmental requirements, and growing competition with other importers. The conclusion suggests that the cooperation between Chinaand the Middle East not only goes on but is transforming from simple crude oil trade to a multi-component model. This model includes: 1. different types of en­ergy (oil + gas + renewables + hydrogen), 2. different technologies (carbon capture, nuclear energy), and 3. new financial mechanisms (yuan settlements). В статье представлен комплексный анализ развития топлив­но-энергетического сотрудничества между Китайской Народной Республи­кой и государствами Ближнего Востока. В условиях растущей энергетической зависимости КНР, где на импортную нефть приходится более 70% от ее об­щего объема потребления в стране, а доля ближневосточных поставщиков составляет около 50%, данное партнерство приобретает стратегическое зна­чение для глобальной энергетической безопасности. Целью настоящего ис­следования является анализ текущего состояния и перспектив китайско-ближневосточных отношений в энергетической сфере. В статье подробно рассматриваются исторические этапы сотрудничества: от первых контрактов 1990-х гг. до современности, отмеченной развитием Инициативы «Пояс и путь» и глобальным энергопереходом. Особое внима­ние уделяется ключевым партнерам Китая в регионе (Саудовская Аравия, Иран, ОАЭ, Ирак, Катар), анализируются объемы и структура торговли неф­тью и сжиженным природным газом, а также инвестиции китайских корпо­раций (CNPC, Sinopec) в разработку месторождений и инфраструктурные проекты. Также отмечаются основные механизмы экономического взаимо­действия, включая долгосрочные контракты и финансовые инструменты,   и ана­лизируются современные тенденции, связанные с декарбонизацией и развитием «зеленой» и водородной энергетики. title: СТРАТЕГИИ И ИНТЕРЕСЫ КИТАЯ, ЯПОНИИ И ЮЖНОЙ КОРЕИ В АРКТИКЕ КАК ПОТЕНЦИАЛЬНЫЙ ФАКТОР СОТРУДНИЧЕСТВА С РОССИЕЙ
title_original: СТРАТЕГИИ И ИНТЕРЕСЫ КИТАЯ, ЯПОНИИ И ЮЖНОЙ КОРЕИ В АРКТИКЕ КАК ПОТЕНЦИАЛЬНЫЙ ФАКТОР СОТРУДНИЧЕСТВА С РОССИЕЙ
summary:
В статье анализируются национальные стратегии и ключевые интересы ведущих экономик Восточной Азии — Китая, Японии и Южной Кореи — в Арктическом регионе. Автор рассматривает эволюцию подходов этих государств к освоению высоких широт, выделяя их приоритетные направления, которые включают в себя обеспечение энергетической безопасности, развитие транспортно-логистического потенциала Северного морского пути (СМП), проведение фундаментальных климатических исследований, арктическое судостроение и ряд других. Показано, что приоритеты исследуемых азиатских стран в регионе имеют как общие черты, так и различия в подходах к реализации арктической повестки. Особое внимание уделяется выявлению точек соприкосновения интересов азиатских «игроков» с национальными приоритетами Российской Федерации в Арктике. В работе оцениваются перспективы и риски международного сотрудничества в условиях текущей геополитической обстановке, включая вопросы инвестиций в СПГ-проекты, технологическое партнерство в судостроении и формирование новых полярных маршрутов. Показано, что ситуация в контексте Россия — Азия по арктической повестке характеризуется глубокой асимметрией, поcкольку сотрудничество России и Китая развивается активно, несмотря на текущую геополитическую ситуацию. Взаимодействие же с Южной Кореtй временно заморожено, но на фоне Японии его возобновление представляется наиболее вероятным в ближайшем будущем. В свою очередь реакция Японии на события 2022 г. среди всех азиатских стран оказалась наиболее недружественной для РФ, и в этой связи возобновление сотрудничества с Россией в ближайшей перспективе видится маловероятным. Сотрудничество же с Китаем динамично развивается. Китайские компании, хотя и с осторожностью, вызванной санкционными рисками, продолжают участвовать в проектах. Применительно к Японии ситуация противоположная. Диалог на официальном уровне заморожен. Условием для его возобновления МИД РФ называет отказ Японии от антироссийского курса. В свою очередь Южная Корея находится в промежуточном положении. Санкции привели к заморозке контрактов на судостроение, что нанесло ущерб высокотехнологичному сегменту сотрудничества. Однако Арктика стала для Москвы и Сеула «зоной вынужденной паузы», но не окончательного разрыва. Сохраняются научные и гуманитарные контакты, а южнокорейские эксперты активно участвуют в форумах, посвященных СМП.
                  This article analyzes the national strategies and key interests of East Asia's leading economies—China, Japan, and South Korea —in the Arctic region. The author examines the evolution of these states’ approaches to high-latitude development, highlighting priority areas, including energy security, developing the transport and logistics potential of the Northern Sea Route (NSR), conducting fundamental climate research, Arctic shipbuilding, and others. It demonstrates that the priorities of the Asian countries studied in the region share both commonalities and differences in their approaches. Particular attention is paid to identifying points of convergence between the interests of Asian players and the national priorities of the Russian Federation in the Arctic. The paper assesses the prospects and risks of international cooperation amid the current geopolitical transformation, including investment in LNG projects, technological partnerships in shipbuilding, and the development of new polar routes. It also demonstrates that the situation in the Russia-Asia triangle regarding the Arctic agenda is characterized by profound asymmetry: since cooperation between Russia and China is developing actively, despite the current geopolitical situation, interaction with South Korea is temporarily frozen, but against the backdrop of Japan, its resumption seems most likely in the near future. In turn, Japan’s position on the events of 2022 among all Asian countries turned out to be the most unfriendly for the RF and, in this regard, the resumption of cooperation with Russia in the near future seems unlikely. Cooperation with China is developing dynamically. Chinese companies, albeit cautiously due to sanctions risks, continue to participate in projects. The situation with Japan is the opposite. Official dialogue has been frozen. The Russian Foreign Ministry states that a condition for its resumption is Japan’s abandonment of its anti-Russian policies. South Korea, meanwhile, finds itself in an intermediate position. Sanctions have led to the freezing of shipbuilding contracts, damaging hightech cooperation. However, the Arctic has become a «forced pause» for Moscow and Seoul, not a permanent rupture. Scientific and humanitarian contacts remain, and South Korean experts actively participate in forums devoted to the NSR.

title: The history and relevance of mechanics in the training of engineering personnel: a pedagogical aspect
title_original: The history and relevance of mechanics in the training of engineering personnel: a pedagogical aspect
summary: The chapter examines the historical development of mechanics as one of the oldest and most multidisciplinary branches of engineering – from the simplest devices of antiquity used for lifting and moving heavy loads to modern mechanical engineering, encompassing the design of vehicles, industrial systems, and even spacecraft. It demonstrates the inseparable connection of mechanics with physics, mathematics, and geometry, as well as its key role in driving innovation and technological progress. The growing importance of predicting the behavior of structures not yet built in modern engineering is noted, along with the need for close interaction between theory and practice: real-world practice poses new problems for theory, while theory finds the foundation for scientific research in practical work. It is emphasized that many engineering faculties have incorporated theoretical mechanics and the theory of machines and mechanisms into their mechanical engineering curricula. Modern engineers are required to study fundamental disciplines, including the laws of theoretical mechanics, in order to understand the logic of the development of accumulated scientific knowledge and to apply it effectively to solve current engineering challenges.

title: ИСТОРИЯ ФОРМИРОВАНИЯ И ПЕРСПЕКТИВЫ ПЕРЕРАБОТКИ ОКИСЛЕННЫХ ЗАБАЛАНСОВЫХ РУД МЕСТОРОЖДЕНИЯ КАЛЬМАКЫР
title_original: ИСТОРИЯ ФОРМИРОВАНИЯ И ПЕРСПЕКТИВЫ ПЕРЕРАБОТКИ ОКИСЛЕННЫХ ЗАБАЛАНСОВЫХ РУД МЕСТОРОЖДЕНИЯ КАЛЬМАКЫР
summary: The history of the development of the Kalmakyr copper-porphyry deposit and the prerequisites for the formation of technogenic dumps of oxidized off-balance ore have been examined. It has been shown that long-term open-pit development of the deposit was accompanied by the selective storage of raw materials that did not meet the requirements of current flotation technology. Using dumps No 9 and No 39, the resource potential of accumulated ores containing copper, gold, and silver is characterized. The mineralogical and technological characteristics of oxidized raw materials, which limit the direct application of traditional sulfide flotation, have been analyzed. Promising development directions have been substantiated: geological and technological mapping of dumps, separate preparation of technological types, sulfuric acid bulk and tank leaching, combined schemes for extracting copper and noble metals, solution circulation, and digital process control. Laboratory experiments show that 75–80% of copper can be extracted during tank leaching, but industrial implementation requires enlarged testing, a closed material balance, and a technical-economic comparison of the variants.

title: Дубовая кружевница Corythucha arcuata (Say, 1832): таксономическая история и распространение
title_original: Дубовая кружевница Corythucha arcuata (Say, 1832): таксономическая история и распространение
summary:
Статья посвящена анализу систематического положения и распространения инвазивного вредителя – дубовой кружевницы Corythucha arcuata (Say, 1832) (Hemiptera: Tingidae). В работе приведена история таксономического изучения вида, начиная с первоописания и последующего объединения ряда близких форм в единый вид. Детально рассмотрено распространение C. arcuata в естественном (аборигенном) ареале – Северной Америке. Анализ исторических сведений и современных данных показал, что к настоящему времени вид зарегистрирован в 40 штатах США и 3-х провинциях Канады, а его инвазионный ареал охватывает большую часть Европы и южные регионы России.
                  This article is devoted to the analysis of the taxonomic status and distribution of the invasive pest – the oak lace bug Corythucha arcuata (Say, 1832) (Hemiptera: Tingidae). The paper traces the history of the taxonomic study of the species, from its original description to the subsequent amalgamation of a number of closely related forms into a single species. The distribution of C. arcuata within its natural (native) range – North America – is examined in detail. An analysis of historical records and current data has shown that, to date, the species has been recorded in 40 US states and 3 Canadian provinces, while its invasive range covers most of Europe and the southern regions of Russia.

title: ИСТОРИЯ СТАНОВЛЕНИЯ И ИНСТИТУЦИОНАЛЬНОГО РАЗВИТИЯ РЕСПУБЛИКАНСКОГО ЦЕНТРА НАЦИОНАЛЬНЫХ КУЛЬТУР (1994 – ПЕРВАЯ ЧЕТВЕРТЬ XXI ВЕКА)
title_original: ИСТОРИЯ СТАНОВЛЕНИЯ И ИНСТИТУЦИОНАЛЬНОГО РАЗВИТИЯ РЕСПУБЛИКАНСКОГО ЦЕНТРА НАЦИОНАЛЬНЫХ КУЛЬТУР (1994 – ПЕРВАЯ ЧЕТВЕРТЬ XXI ВЕКА)
summary:
В статье рассматривается история создания, становления и институционального развития Республиканского центра национальных культур (РЦНК) в Минске в контексте реализации государственной этнокультурной политики Республики Беларусь. На основе архивных материалов, нормативных актов и научных исследований анализируются социально-политические предпосылки возникновения Центра в условиях суверенизации страны и распада советской идентификационной модели. Прослеживаются основные этапы организационного развития РЦНК начиная с его учреждения в 1994 году и первых лет деятельности, когда он выполнял преимущественно методические и информационные функции, и заканчивая периодом 2000–2010-х годов, когда Центр обрел собственную материально-техническую базу и развернутую инфраструктуру. В статье исследуются механизмы взаимодействия РЦНК с государственными органами управления, включая Министерство культуры, Координационный совет по делам национальных меньшинств и Аппарат Уполномоченного по делам религий и национальностей. Анализируетсяправовая основа этой деятельности, закрепленная в Законе «О национальных меньшинствах» и последующих нормативных документах. Раскрывается роль Центра как посредника между государством и этническими общностями в вопросах сохранения культурного наследия, языкового образования и организации массовых мероприятий. Особое внимание уделяется процессу становления РЦНК как мощного координационного узла, связывающегогосударство и более 150 этнических общностей. Аргументируются выводы об эволюции государственной политики Республики Беларусь в сфере межнациональных отношений, ее адаптации к новым вызовам этнокультурного развития.
                  This article examines the establishment, formation, and institutional development of the Republican Center for National Cultures (RCNC) in Minsk within the framework of Belarus's state policy on ethnocultural affairs. Drawing on archival materials, legal and regulatory documents, and scholarly studies, it analyzes the socio-political preconditions for the Center's creation against the backdrop of Belarus's emergence as a sovereign state and the collapse of Soviet identity structures. The article traces the main stages of the RCNC's organizational growth: from its founding in 1994 and its early years, when its role was primarily to provide methodological and informational support, to the 2000s and 2010s, when the Center acquired its own premises, technical capacity, and a broad infrastructure. It further examines the mechanisms of the RCNC's interaction with state authorities, including the Ministry of Culture, the Coordinating Council for National Minorities, and the Office of the Commissioner for Religious and Ethnic Affairs. The legal framework governing these activities, as set out in the Law "On National Minorities" and subsequent regulatory documents, is also analyzed. The article highlights the Center's role as an intermediary between the state and ethnic communities in preserving cultural heritage, supporting language education, and organizing cultural events. Particular attention is paid to the RCNC's transformation into a key coordinating body linking the state with more than 150 ethnic communities. The article concludes that the Center's development reflects the evolution of Belarus's state policy in the sphere of interethnic relations and its adaptation to new challenges in ethnocultural development.

title: ПОЛИТИЧЕСКИЙ АВЕРРОИЗМ: ИСТОРИЯ ОДНОГО МИФА
title_original: ПОЛИТИЧЕСКИЙ АВЕРРОИЗМ: ИСТОРИЯ ОДНОГО МИФА
summary: The article offers a critical analysis of the concept of «political Averroism» – a historiographical construct that emerged in the late 19th and early 20th centuries and was used to describe a distinctive current in the political philosophy of the late Middle Ages. The author traces the genesis of the term, linking it to the interpretations of E. Renan and P. Mandonnet, and demonstrates that political Averroism was from the very outset a conceptually thin notion, whose content was reducible to the idea of a strict separation between the secular and the spiritual spheres. Yet this conceptual poverty was offset by the appeal of simplicity, which for a long time led scholars to see in political Averroism the origins of modern political thought. The article examines the key stages in the critique of this notion in 20th-century historiography – from the work of F. van Steenberghen to the studies of J. Marenbon – which show that Latin Averroism as a coherent movement, and even more so its political offshoot, lacked convincing evidence.

title: Everyday Creativity as a Mechanism of Social Self-Transformation:  The Concept of Cultural Energy
title_original: Everyday Creativity as a Mechanism of Social Self-Transformation:  The Concept of Cultural Energy
summary: The article examines the philosophical status of everyday creativity, presented as one of the mechanisms of social self-transformation, and substantiates the concept of cultural energy as a condition for its historical productivity. The initial problem is the transition from the local production of novelty in everyday practices to culturally and historically significant change. The methodological framework of the research consists of a com-parative-philosophical reconstruction, supplemented by a problem-oriented and categorical comparison of sacred, evolutionary, systemic, anthropological, and existential models of cultural novelty. The article substanti-ates the distinction between “creativity” as an activity-based capacity to produce and appropriate novelty, “fluc-tuation” as a possible mode of the emergence of local differences, and “creation” as an event that changes the horizon of the possible. It is shown that the historical productivity of everyday creativity is determined not by the quantity or quality of innovations; rather, their generation stems from the openness of the socio-cultural system to meaning-making, free action, collective appropriation, recognition, and the institutional consolidation of the new. The cultural energy is interpreted as an integral property of social reality that enables the transformation of local differences into stable forms of cultural and social self-transformation. The article concludes that creativity is not a self-sufficient source of historical change and does not directly produce meaning but can serve as a space for the actualization of cultural novelty, meaning-making, and self-transcendence.

title: The Competition of Models of Pomor Identity  in Historiography of the Late 20th – First Quarter of the 21st Century: State and Prospects
title_original: The Competition of Models of Pomor Identity  in Historiography of the Late 20th – First Quarter of the 21st Century: State and Prospects
summary: The article is devoted to the issue of the essence of the concepts related to the problem of ethnogenesis and ethnocultural identity of the Pomors in modern historical discourse. The author provides a name for two oppos-ing models emerged due to the different formats of the address to the preceding academic heritage as well as fundamentally diverse methodological and geopolitical foundations; a comprehensive assessment of their arguments is carried out based on an analysis of the works of the most significant representatives. A number of arbitrary assumptions and contradictions of the diffuse‑constructivist model are identified. It is concluded that the intensity of competition between the models of Pomor identity is ultimately determined by the confrontation between strategies of discrediting and rehabilitating the history of the Russian state. The recommendations are proposed for implementing a strategy for their interaction including abandoning the extreme postmodernist concepts of ethnogenesis, reducing the appealing to non-Russian cultural and genetic substrates, narrowing the chronotopic localization of the “Pomorye” concept, and breaking away from the Westernized geopolitical context.

title: Historiography of Kyrgyzstan’s  Contribution to the USSR Victory in the Great Patriotic War:  The Soviet Period (1941–1991)
title_original: Historiography of Kyrgyzstan’s  Contribution to the USSR Victory in the Great Patriotic War:  The Soviet Period (1941–1991)
summary: The article examines the historiography of Kyrgyzstan’s contribution to the USSR victory in the Great Patriotic War within the chronological framework of the Soviet period (1941–1991). Based on historiographical analysis, two key stages in the study of the problem are highlighted: wartime historiography (1941–1945) and post-war Soviet historiography (1946–1991), within which the perestroika years (1985–1991) constituted a specific phase marked by the beginning of a revision of the ideological dogmas and the emergence of new publica-tions reflecting the social costs of wartime. The evolution of approaches to the research of mobilization pro-cesses, labour heroism, and Kyrgyz society adaptation to the conditions of war is traced. The scientific novelty of the work is determined not only by the systematization of historiographical material across four problem-thematic areas, but also by the introduction into scientific circulation of a number of previously unused docu-ments and literature titles as well as by the drawing the perestroika-era publications reflecting the beginning of a critical revision of established concepts. The author concludes that Soviet historiography evolved from agita-tional and journalistic publications to the academic researches, however, it retained ideological determinism expressed in the conceptualization of “conflict-free unity of the front and rear” and an insufficiently critical as-sessment of the socio-economic problems of the wartime home front.

title: Forms of Fictitious Culture as Artifacts  of the Fake Creation of Subjects
title_original: Forms of Fictitious Culture as Artifacts  of the Fake Creation of Subjects
summary: The article attempts a comprehensive cultural and philosophical analysis of various forms of fictitious culture and related imitation and simulation types of creation, which have not yet received an adequate coverage in the modern research space. The object of the study is pseudo-culture, quasi-culture, para-culture, anti-culture, counter-culture, and post-culture as modern forms of culture. The subject of the study is a fake creation as an ontological source of the above-mentioned cultural forms. The aim of the research is to provide a semantic clarification and an essential differentiation of both these cultural forms and the various types of activity of the subject that lie at the bottom of them. To realize this goal, in this work, based on the analysis of current re-search, the principles and forms of postmodern aesthetics are revealed as well as modern mass culture gen-eral features are articulated. The study also identifies the essential characteristics of each form of fictitious cul-ture highlight the key destructive intentions that present in the ontological spaces of these cultural forms, and the semantic contours of the demarcation lines between them are outlined. The scientific novelty of the re-search results in the development of definitions of the above-mentioned forms of fictitious culture and relevant types of fake creation.

title: Socio-Philosophical Determinants of Youth Cultural Safety in the Age of Digitalization
title_original: Socio-Philosophical Determinants of Youth Cultural Safety in the Age of Digitalization
summary: The article presents a comprehensive socio-philosophical analysis of the problem of ensuring Russian youth cultural security in the context of the total digitalization of the modern socio-cultural space. The research focus-es on identifying and resolving the fundamental contradiction between the limitless possibilities of digital per-sonality development and the increasing risks of destructive influence on the value system of the younger gen-eration. The paper examines key aspects of digital socialization of young people including the formation of clip way of thinking, information perception patterns changing and the transformation of traditional mechanisms of cultural experience transmission. Special attention is paid to the analysis of risks associated with the spread of destructive content, manipulative technologies in the digital environment and the threat of blurring traditional value orientations. The mechanisms of formation of information hygiene and media literacy as protective fac-tors of cultural safety are investigated. Within the framework of the research, practical solutions are proposed to ensure an individual’s digital sovereignty in the context of the digital transformation of the society.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Humanities Education: The Transformation of Subjectivity and Responsibility in the Digital Environment
title_original: Artificial Intelligence in Humanities Education: The Transformation of Subjectivity and Responsibility in the Digital Environment
summary: The article analyzes the transformation of authorship, responsibility, and subjectivity also in humanitarian edu-cation under the influence of artificial intelligence. Based on J. Baudrillard’s simulacrum concepts and E. Fromm’s modes of existence ones, the authors substantiate the conditions, under which neural networks act as a means of expanding subjectivity, rather than a tool for simulating knowledge. The proposed model of criti-cal prompting is presented as a practice of maintaining an author’s position and ethical responsibility in the digital environment where the role functions, i. e. fact checker, co-editor, form the habit of verification and re-flection. It is proved that the correct use of AI transforms the student from a consumer of algorithms into an ac-tive participant in the joint production of knowledge. The research pays the attention on the importance of stu-dents’ ethical responsibility and their operational participation in responce to the fact when the technologies are keeping on considerable influence on the education practices.

title: The Ontological Foundations of the Reality of Harmony  in V.T. Meshcheryakov’s Philosophical System
title_original: The Ontological Foundations of the Reality of Harmony  in V.T. Meshcheryakov’s Philosophical System
summary: The purpose of the study is to make the understanding of harmony closer to the needs of modern including scientific knowledge, based on a critical reflection of modern philosophical theories. Although the starting point of the work is V.T. Meshcheryakov’s theory, his ideas are presented as a statement of problems that have not been solved by the author himself. The article continues their solution in the perspective of modern approaches and methods. If in classical philosophy harmony is understood as a static, non-empirical ideal, then today it is advisable to consider it, on the one side, as a dynamic parameter of the system, an indicator of its viability and stability in conditions of imbalance and variations, on the other side, as a feature of consciousness to monitor the integrity of the system during its radical morphological changes. The research methods include a dialectical method used to identify mechanisms for overcoming contradictions in the dynamics of systems; a systematic approach that is important for determining the criteria for the integrity, autonomy, and functional relationships of the system; a synergetic paradigm that allows to establish the nature of changes under the influence of the ex-ternal environment and the return of the system to a stable state; a phenomenological method to specify the risk of replacing the objective processes of harmonization with cognitive constructs of consciousness. The nov-elty of the work lies in the phenomenological substantiation of harmony as a cognitive tool for structuring reali-ty. The results of the paper show that harmony manifests itself as a universal mechanism of a special percep-tion of reality, which makes it possible to detect patterns in the dynamic nonequilibrium systems liable to the modulation in their set of functions and relationships. The following indicators of harmony have been estimat-ed: integrity, conformity (functional and complementary), optimal balance of opposites, and the ability of the system to return to a steady state after nonequilibrium ones in the process of change. Thus, harmony, in one respect, has an objective component derived from the system’s ability to maintain integrity and necessary func-tions as applied to changes, choose the optimal vector of changes, and restore connections in the event of sudden changes. Opposite, the concept of harmony is a cognitive tool of consciousness necessary for con-structing the holistic representations of objects preserving the unity of attitude towards a thing or system, and substantiating the possibility of the existence of a system with its fundamental morphological changes.

title: Phygital Art as a Response to the Crisis of NFT Art:  A Culturological Analysis of Transforming  Digital Art Practices
title_original: Phygital Art as a Response to the Crisis of NFT Art:  A Culturological Analysis of Transforming  Digital Art Practices
summary: The article presents a culturological analysis of phygital art as a possible structural response to the multilevel crisis of NFT art. The relevance of the research is driven by the need to re-evaluate phygital practices, the de-velopment of which slowed down amidst the collapse of the crypto art market. The author identifies the key reasons for the NFT model crash: the speculative nature of the art market, the dematerialization of the artistic experience, institutional inadequacy, and the “inflation of novelty”. The study substantiates the hypothesis, which suggests that phygital art, thanks to the organic synthesis of digital and physical dimensions, is capable to overcome these conceptual expenses. Particular attention is paid to the capacity of phygital art for institution-al rootedness and the purchasing strata unification – the young audience of the digital era and traditional col-lectors. It is concluded that phygital art represents a dialectical overcoming of the limitations of both purely ana-log and virtual art in tune, acting as a promising paradigm for the development of artistic culture in the post-digital era.

title: The Concept of “Identity” in Social Philosophy: A Conceptual Analysis of Chinese Scholars’ Research
title_original: The Concept of “Identity” in Social Philosophy: A Conceptual Analysis of Chinese Scholars’ Research
summary: The article is devoted to the conceptual analysis of the concept of “identity” in Chinese studies in social philos-ophy, cultural exploring, psychology, and media theory. The research problem is not an insufficient comparison of definitions and models of identity within the selected interdisciplinary corpus. The paper aims to build an integrative model of the concept of identity that clarifies the relation between social foundations, subjective ex-perience, memory, structural forms, and dynamics. The material comprises twelve Chinese publications: elev-en articles from 2020 to 2025 and one terminological article from 2004. This corpus was presented according to the topics, disciplinary range, and the presence of a definition, classification or model of identity. The con-ceptual analysis includes the identification of such units, comparison of their functions in the authors’ argu-ments, and the synthesis of the results. It was established that the study shows that the analyzed corpus inter-prets identity as a person’s socio-historically conditioned and reflexively experienced attitude to him or herself, social groups, and the cultural world. Memory ensures a temporal continuity, digital mediation changes the storage and presentation of the experience, while hybridity and shifts in scales of belonging explain the varia-bility of identity. The proposed model does not claim a universal validity, but it provides a basis for further cross-cultural comparison.

title: China’s State Policy in the Field of Historical Memory and Its Influence on the Modernization Strategy
title_original: China’s State Policy in the Field of Historical Memory and Its Influence on the Modernization Strategy
summary: Historical memory as a form of collective social consciousness performs the functions of social construction and serves as a key elements linking national historical experience with modern social practice. From the point of view of social philosophy, this article analyzes the mechanism and dialectical boundaries of the influence of historical memory on the implementation of China’s modernization strategy. The study shows that historical memory implements a triple function in the process of China’s modernization. The spiritual dimension provides the basis for legitimacy, while the institutional dimension, based on the national system of memorial rituals, shapes a value consensus and ensures social mobilization. The international dimension is used as a symbolic capital to supply with the participation in a strategic identity generating. The main theoretical contribution of the work is to clarify the dynamic interpretation of dialectical relationships between historical memory and China’s modernization strategy.

title: “...Not for Oneself, not for Others, but with All and for All...“: Materials for a Historiographical Description of the Philosophical Fate  of Nikolai Fedorovich Fedorov and His Followers, the Fedorovites  (On the 120th Anniversary of the Publication of the First Volume  of the “Philosophy of the Common Cause”)
title_original: “...Not for Oneself, not for Others, but with All and for All...“: Materials for a Historiographical Description of the Philosophical Fate  of Nikolai Fedorovich Fedorov and His Followers, the Fedorovites  (On the 120th Anniversary of the Publication of the First Volume  of the “Philosophy of the Common Cause”)
summary: The paper presents a historiographical overview of the philosophical legacy of Nikolai Fedorovich Fedorov and the activities of his followers, the “Fedorovites”. Based on an analysis of an extensive body of sources, includ-ing the Fedorov’s own works, memoirs of contemporaries, and studies by historians of Russian philosophy, the paper examines the evolution of perception of the “Philosophy of Common Cause” from the publication of the first volume in 1906 to modern interpretations. Particular attention is paid to the ambiguous biographical image of the thinker, which combines the traits of a righteous philosopher and an ascetic “eccentric”, as well as to the key provisions of his teaching. The central place among these is occupied by the idea of the active resurrection of ancestors as a duty of human sons. The influence of Fedorov’s ideas on various spheres is analyzed ‒ from literature and art (A. Platonov, V. Bryusov) to political practices (issues concerning preservation of V.I. Lenin’s body), along with the multidirectional reactions they provoked from church thinkers, Marxist critics, and repre-sentatives of academic science. The study traces the transformation of the doctrine from “Fedorovism” to “Fe-dorovianism” and examines modern attempts to comprehend his ideas in the context of cultural memory and the ethical imperative. In conclusion, it is argued that N.F. Fedorov’s philosophy represents not so much a uto-pia as a relevant challenge requiring re-evaluation by each new generation.

title: Intelligence between Truth and Operation:  A Cultural-Philosophical Genealogy of the Concept
title_original: Intelligence between Truth and Operation:  A Cultural-Philosophical Genealogy of the Concept
summary: The article demonstrates that the contemporary usage of the concept of “intelligence” is the result of a long cul-tural transformation, during which metaphysically and normatively rich notions of mind were partially translated into the language of operations, abilities, and measurable differences. The methodological basis of the study includes historical-philosophical reconstruction, comparative conceptual analysis, and cultural-philosophical interpretation of intellectual practices. Three interrelated dimensions of the concept of “intelligence” are identi-fied: operational, semantic-normative, and situational-distributed. Their correlation is traced in ancient philoso-phy, scholasticism, classical rationalism, German classical philosophy, psychometrics, and comparative cogni-tion. It is argued that modern understanding of intelligence represents a gradual and profiled cognitive ability whose observability depends on culturally organized situations. The scientific novelty lies in interpreting the intelligence operationalization as a cultural process of autonomy of individual cognitive actions while maintain-ing an implicit dependence on norms of truth, education, embodiment, and environment.

title: Consciousness and AI
title_original: Consciousness and AI
summary: The primary aim of this article is to establish the presence and/or absence of consciousness in artificial intelli-gence (AI). To achieve this, the authors address the following research objectives: to characterize existing ap-proaches to understanding the nature of AI, to identify their strengths and weaknesses, to determine which ap-proach allows for establishing the presence and/or absence of consciousness in AI, and to identify social and humanitarian factors that hinder an adequate assessment of AI. The object of this study is AI, and the subject is the problem of whether it possesses consciousness. To solve this problem, the authors draw on the behaviorist approach (the Turing test), which has been in use until recently, and the relatively new functionalist approach. Using the method of critical analysis, the authors substantiate the inadequacy of applying the behaviorist ap-proach in assessing the presence and/or absence of consciousness in AI. This approach is based on the out-dated notion of consciousness as an exclusive property of human nature and does not allow for an objective assessment of the presence of consciousness in AI. In contrast to the behaviorist approach, the functionalist approach allows for subjective experience without a permanent “self” and provides grounds for believing that not only humans but also artificial systems can possess consciousness. In conclusion, it is argued that the ap-plication of the functionalist approach will help overcome society’s cautious attitude toward AI and harness its potential for the progressive development of humanity.

title: The Transformation of the Concept of ψυχή  in the Classical Period of Ancient Philosophy
title_original: The Transformation of the Concept of ψυχή  in the Classical Period of Ancient Philosophy
summary: The article examines the transformation of the philosophical conception of ψυχή (soul) during the period of classical Greek philosophy within the doctrines of Plato and Aristotle. The study is conducted within the frame-work of historical-philosophical research on ancient anthropology. The relevance is determined by the absence (at least in the domestic literature) of the detailed investigation devoted, in one respect, to the transformation of pre-philosophical (in particular, Orphic) and natural-philosophical beliefs of ψυχή into fully-fledged “psycholog-ical models” in Europe for the first time – Plato’s model of ψυχή-soul and Aristotle’s model of ψυχή-form – but then to the interrelation between these models. The work allows to learn in depth and from many sides the philosophical-anthropological projects of these thinkers detemining properly their place in the anthropological tradition that existed in Greece at the time. The aim of the work is to analyze the doctrines of Plato and Aristo-tle’s ψυχή, to construct their “psychological models”, and to define both their conceptual connection and their differences. This determines the following tasks: 1) to trace the formation of Plato’s conceptions of ψυχή in his dialogues (including the early ones), while simultaneously constructing, on the basis of its characteristics of Plato’s “metaphysical model” of ψυχή as an ideal οὐσία-εἶδος represented in the form of a winged chariot; 2) to specify the essential features of Aristotle’s view on the nature, structure, and functions of ψυχή, and to build his “realistic model” of ψυχή as the form that organizes the body; 3) to describe the conceptual differences in Plato and Aristotle’s “psychological models”.                   The methodological basis is comprised by historical-philosophical and hermeneutic approaches as well as the elements of comparative analysis. In conclusion, it is noted that ψυχή at Plato and Aristotle possess a significantly different ontological status, which predetermines substantial differences in future anthropological systems erected on either of the “psychological models” of these great philosophers.

title: The Rhineland Crisis of 1936. A Diplomatic History
title_original: The Rhineland Crisis of 1936. A Diplomatic History
summary: The article examines a diplomatic battle connected with remilitarization of the Rhineland by Nazi Germany. On the basis of documents of National Archives in London, the author analyses the positions of European powers and their reaction to the challenging action of the leadership of the Third Reich. Archival materials show that this Hitler’s action was highly risky, since the Western powers had sufficient military potential to fight back against the Nazis and to prevent the remilitarization of the Rhineland zone. But they did not do so due to a se-ries of reasons connected with the policy of appeasement and the wish of the ruling circles of Great Britain and France to come to terms with Hitler, thereby avoiding involvement in war. The article analyses consequences of the remilitarization of the Rhineland, reaction of European powers, and the impact of this action on peace and security in Europe.

title: Engagement as a Value-Based Foundation  for Transforming the Boundaries of Digital Communities
title_original: Engagement as a Value-Based Foundation  for Transforming the Boundaries of Digital Communities
summary: The boundaries of digital communities are systematically permeable; however, the question of why this per-meability favors conflictual rather than neutral context crossings remains open. Studies on the value-laden na-ture of technical systems and the axiology of metrics demonstrate that artifacts embody values and that a met-ric can displace the very goal it was meant to measure – but these studies do not explore how this happens at the level of specific social structures. The article aims to fill this gap by examining engagement as an axiologi-cal foundation of digital space. Methodologically, the study is structured as a socio-philosophical reconstruction of the relationship between content selection criteria and forms of social connection. The article shows that en-gagement serves as the connecting link – a metric functioning within platform architectures as an operational substitute for “the good”. The structural instability of digital communities thus receives an axiological explana-tion: it stems from the implicit value embedded in the objective function of platform algorithms, rather than from the impersonal technical properties of the environment.

title: The Image of the City and Commemoration in the Practice of Forming Cultural Memory and Intergenerational Connections
title_original: The Image of the City and Commemoration in the Practice of Forming Cultural Memory and Intergenerational Connections
summary: This article proposes a topic for discussion on commemoration as a cultural process that not only exhibits resil-ience in its classical forms but also actively embraces and utilizes new communicative, technological, and creative practices. Commemoration encompasses not only the memory of traumas and epic events of the past, but also the memory of urban development, scientific discoveries, historical events of local significance, and so on. The article provides an overview of theoretical approaches to the concept under consideration and, based on these materials, analyzes real cases of commemorative practices at the Murmansk Regional Art Museum (the “SkulpturNO!” and “Art in a Familiar Route” projects) and the Murmansk Arctic University (the “Sea on the City Streets” project). It concludes that the diversity of forms of commodification creates a reliable system of cultural values and reference points.

title: China’s Ecological Modernization:  The Transformation of Rational Forms and Value Orientations:  A Socio‑Philosophical Analysis
title_original: China’s Ecological Modernization:  The Transformation of Rational Forms and Value Orientations:  A Socio‑Philosophical Analysis
summary: Since its birth, Western ecological modernization theory has been based on the profound instrumental rational logic understanding the nature as a “resource bank” that can be manipulated by technologies and possible to be priced at the market. Discourse transformation trend from instrumental rationality to priority of values con-nected to environment protection is traced. Chinese-style ecological modernization has shown a fundamental paradigm transformation from instrumental rationality to survival value: it has surpassed Western dualistic thinking and technological tools theory tendencies on the basis of philosophy, and has realized the dialectical synthesis of economic, ecological, and value rationality. Building upon the social philosophy methodological apparatus (dialectics, axiology, social ontology), the author considers the core category of the discourse of “en-vironmental and ontological value orientation”, systematically analizes the inner dialectical logic of the para-digm transformation, and excavates its theoretical value for the criticism of modernity and the construction of a new type of civilization.

title: Danish Defence Policy and NATO (1949‒1965)
title_original: Danish Defence Policy and NATO (1949‒1965)
summary: The article examines Danish defence policy in 1949‒1965 in the context of Denmark’s relationship with NATO. Drawing on archival materials, the author demonstrates that despite its modest military capabilities, Denmark secured a remarkably strong positions within the North Atlantic Alliance. In the 1950s and 1960s, Copenhagen successfully negotiated the establishment of the Allied Forces Baltic Approaches (BALTAP) on its own terms and secured recognition of its right to decline the peacetime stationing of allied air forces and nuclear weapons on Danish soil. While these defence reservations represented a departure from Atlantic solidarity, they were non-binding in nature and could be withdrawn at any time. Crucially, however, they did not apply to Greenland and the Faroe Islands, where strategic installations vital to NATO and the US defence were deployed. It stands to reason it was ultimately political control over these insular territories that provided the Danish leadership with some room for manoeuvre on matters of defence policy in Europe that Copenhagen regarded as crucial.

title_original: The Chinese Piano School  under the Global Musical Space:  Traditions, Borrowings, and Prospects
summary: The article examines the Chinese piano school as an independent cultural and performance system formed through the interaction among national, Western European, and Russian musical and pedagogical traditions. The study aims to identify the mechanisms of incorporating the borrowed models into national practice and how they became a resource for China’s participation in the global musical space. The work methodology combines historical-cultural, comparative-typological, and institutional approaches, cultural transfer theory, and elements of performance analysis. title: The Fundamental Unit of Analysis  as a Methodological Category for Studying Scientific Theory
title_original: The Fundamental Unit of Analysis  as a Methodological Category for Studying Scientific Theory
summary: The article substantiates the need to introduce a new methodological category – the Fundamental Unit of Anal-ysis (FUA) – for studying the principles of organizing the conceptual apparatus of scientific theories. It is shown that existing categories of philosophy and methodology of science do not allow for a systematic description of the internal organization of the system of fundamental concepts within a specific theory. The FUA is defined as a methodological category through which the organizing function in the structure of the conceptual apparatus is investigated, and the category (or system of categories) that performs the organizing function for interrelated fundamental concepts within a unified theoretical system is determined. Criteria for identifying the FUA have been developed, and three possible outcomes of the analysis have been proposed: a single FUA, a distributed organizing function, and a systemic nature of organization. The method has been tested on examples from cell theory, the theory of natural selection, classical mechanics, and activity theory, demonstrating its applicability to theories across various disciplines. The introduction of the FUA provides a basis for the comparative analysis of theories, for the typology of principles governing the conceptual framework organization, and for studying the dynamics of scientific knowledge.

title: “Small Homeland” as a Resource for Preserving the Cultural Heritage  of the Peoples of Mordovia
title_original: “Small Homeland” as a Resource for Preserving the Cultural Heritage  of the Peoples of Mordovia
summary: The article examines various aspects of the concept of “place of power,” which is associated with ethno-cultural features and emotional states that are significant to the local population. The aim of the work is to highlight and use the concept of “small homeland” for preserving the cultural heritage of Mordovia’s peoples. The work ana-lyzes its content, which is traditionally represented as an individual’s place of birth and his or her childhood, but in a broader sense, includes a temporal aspect related to personal socio-cultural integration. The author em-phasizes the importance of local identity, which is formed under the influence of traditions, historical events, and social relations. Local identity does not oppose to national identity but complements it creating a founda-tion for patriotism and respect for cultural diversity. In conclusion, the necessity of citizens’ regular participation in projects that support the ideas of conserving national languages and the ethnocultural code is underscored, which is particularly relevant in the context of contemporary challenges and intercultural interaction complexity.

title: Social Сomposition of the Orenburg Region Officials from the End of the XVIII First Third to the XIX Centuries
title_original: Social Сomposition of the Orenburg Region Officials from the End of the XVIII First Third to the XIX Centuries
summary: The aim of this article is studying the officials’ social composition in the Orenburg province from the late 18th to the first third of the 19th centuries. This work was completed on the basis of the unpublished materials of the formulary lists of the Orenburg province officials from the National Archives of the Republic of Bashkortostan. The issues of the officials’ social composition in the Orenburg province from the late of the 18th to the first third of the 19th centuries has not previously been the subject of specialized academic study. The analysis of the formulary lists facilitated a detailed research of the social composition of officials and clerical workers in the region. The origin directly predetermined their presence or absence of ancestral property, which shaped finally their financial positions. For the convenience of analyzing the officials’ social composition in the Orenburg province, all officials were divided into several conditional groups depending on their social origin; when ana-lyzing the formulary lists, such a factor as the presence or absence of a class rank was taken into account. As a result of the study, the social composition of the officialism in the Orenburg province was identified, the propor-tion of various social groups in the officialism was determined, and the relation between the officials’ social origin and their career growth was revealed.

title: State Support for Front-Line Soldiers’ Families  During the Great Patriotic War  and Its Impact on Family and Marital Relations  (Based on the Material of the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic)
title_original: State Support for Front-Line Soldiers’ Families  During the Great Patriotic War  and Its Impact on Family and Marital Relations  (Based on the Material of the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic)
summary: This article presents an analysis of government authorities’ activity to provide social support to frontline sol-diers’ families during the war in Kabardino-Balkaria (1941-1944). It shows that the main assistance to the peo-ple was provided as the payouts of pensions, benefits, tax breaks, food, consumer goods, a provision of hous-ing, placement of children in childcare facilities, and priority employment. Local emergency agencies, public and Komsomol organizations were established within the government authorities system making a significant contribution to supporting the population during the war. The material concerning certain shortcomings in the work of social assistance agencies is of scholarly interest. For the first time, a new body of archival records has been introduced into scientific use that allowed to trace the main areas of social assistance for the citizens from different perspectives and in more detail. It is concluded that the Great Patriotic War led to a transformation of traditional behavioral practices, which affected the further formation of innovative models of family and marital relations, despite the visible female conservatism that admitted to principally preserve traditional mental atti-tudes as well.

title: Philosophical Foundations of Chinese State Identity:  The History of Formation and Modern Transformations
title_original: Philosophical Foundations of Chinese State Identity:  The History of Formation and Modern Transformations
summary: The article presents the results of a retrospective analysis of the philosophical foundations of Chinese state identity, conceptualized in the idea of “Zhongguo” (“The Middle Kingdom”). The study aims to trace the evolu-tion of this concept from the sacred-geographical ideas during the Western Zhou period to contemporary ideo-logical constructs of the People’s Republic of China. The methodological framework relies on the principles of historicism, systemic approach, historical-philosophical reconstruction, and comparative analysis. The study identifies three fundamental dimensions of archaic identity: sacred-geographical (the center as a source of cosmic order), political (the hierarchical model of “Tianxia”), and the ethno-cultural (the opposition between “Huaxia” and barbarians). During the classical period, Confucianism consolidated the ethical-ritual foundations, Legalism established the institutional apparatus, while Daoism and Buddhism enriched the doctrine with uni-versalist meanings. In the modern era, the concept has transformed into “socialism with Chinese characteris-tics”, the idea of “the Chinese Dream”, and the concept of a “Community of Shared Future for Mankind”. It is argued that in the contemporary discourse, there is not so much rejection of the cultural superiority model as its reformatting into a model of cultural-political leadership, where universalist rhetoric is combined with an em-phasis on the exceptionalism of Chinese civilization.

title: Occupation Economy and Child Labor:  Goals and Objectives of German Policy in the Donbas  during the Great Patriotic War (1941-1943)
title_original: Occupation Economy and Child Labor:  Goals and Objectives of German Policy in the Donbas  during the Great Patriotic War (1941-1943)
summary: This study examines Nazi Germany’s occupation policy in the economic sphere in the Donbas during the Great Patriotic War (1941–1943), as well as the role of child labor in achieving these goals. The sources used include archival documents, eyewitness testimonies, and contemporary scholarly literature. The research methods are historical-descriptive analysis, comparative analysis, and document content analysis, which made it possible to obtain a comprehensive view of the scope and nature of German policy in the Donbas during the Great Patriot-ic War – through the lens of the occupation economy and the use of child labor. The study identifies the main goals of the German occupation policy in the economic domain, such as resource exploitation, forced labor, as well as specific features of involving children in labor activity to achieve strategic goals. Particular attention is paid to the occupiers’ policy of incorporating industrial, raw-material, agricultural, and labor resources of the Donbas into the economic turnover of Germany. The findings help to clarify the mechanisms through which the occupation policy was implemented and its impact on the socio-economic situation in the region during war-time.

title: Worldview Security as a Factor of Protection  under the Influence of Soft Power
title_original: Worldview Security as a Factor of Protection  under the Influence of Soft Power
summary: The article is based on the author’s theoretical and methodological framework applied to the philosophical analysis of the phenomenon of worldview security. This framework relies on the organic theory of national se-curity developed by A.I. Melikhov, within which national security is interpreted not only as a state of protection of state institutions and territorial integrity, but also as the ability of society to self preserve (consolidation in the face of external and internal threats). The object of the study is the national security of the Russian Federation, its role and significance in the context of the use of cognitive warfare – soft power. The subject of the study is worldview security, and the phenomenon of this concept is examined in the context of countering the applica-tion of soft power. The relevance of this research lies in proposing a solution to the issue of adopting preventive measures to neutralize sources of tension arising from the informational impact on society by creating a buffer zone, which is represented by worldview security. The novelty consists in conducting a restorative procedure for the national security system, which is necessary to meet new standards. The work employs methods of social statics and social dynamics, as well as the analysis of social changes and transformations. The dialectical method was actively used, in particular the laws of the transition of quantitative changes into qualitative ones and the unity and struggle of opposites.

title: Global Demand‑And‑Value‑Driven Hype Cycles of Capitalism:  A Socio‑Philosophical Analysis
title_original: Global Demand‑And‑Value‑Driven Hype Cycles of Capitalism:  A Socio‑Philosophical Analysis
summary: Drawing on the authors’ definitions of the phenomenon of human natural needs and the phenomenon of val-ues, the article reveals the logic behind the successive reproduction of three global demand‑and‑value‑driven hype cycles of capitalism: the consumer cycle, the credit cycle, and the investment cycle. The instrumental and media function of the phenomena of pleasure, luxury, and success in launching and intensifying the corre-sponding cycles is identified. The possibility of two modifications of the representation of these phenomena in the public consciousness – the demand‑based and the value‑based – is substantiated. It is shown how the transformation of these phenomena from one modification to another, carried out by the marketing strategy of capitalism, contributes to the intensification of demand‑and‑value hype cycles. In connection with the under-standing of labor in Karl Marx’s social philosophy as an object‑transforming activity, the article identifies the logic of the transformation of the phenomenon of pleasure in the context of capitalism – from a phenomenon accompanying the satisfaction of needs and performing a signaling function into an independent need. The logic of the functioning of luxury as a means of legitimizing capitalist elites is disclosed through and analysis of the spiritual foundations of capitalism in the studies of Max Weber and Thorstein Veblen.

title: Illegal Enrichment of Employees  of the USSR State Committee for Radio Electronics  and the Leningrad Economic Council during the Khrushchev Thaw
title_original: Illegal Enrichment of Employees  of the USSR State Committee for Radio Electronics  and the Leningrad Economic Council during the Khrushchev Thaw
summary: This article examines the mechanisms of illicit enrichment among employees of the USSR State Committee on Radio Electronics and the Leningrad Economic Council during the Khrushchev Thaw. The author analyzes ar-chival documents that are relevant to the Soviet economic and manufacturing sector identifying specific schemes for the theft of scarce radio components and semiconductors that were carried out by organized groups involving intermediaries and retail chain employees. The study demonstrates that the weakening of centralized control resulting from the decentralized governance created favorable conditions for shadow eco-nomic activities. Particular attention is given to the subsequent review of the government agencies, the devel-opment of new accounting methods, and an assessment of the adopted restrictive measures effectiveness. The analysis concludes that the identified abuses were systemic and deeply rooted in the shortcomings of the planned economic system.

title: Anti-Catholicism оn the Pages of the Journals of the Theological Academies of the Russian Empire in the Second Half of the 19th – early 20th Centuries
title_original: Anti-Catholicism оn the Pages of the Journals of the Theological Academies of the Russian Empire in the Second Half of the 19th – early 20th Centuries
summary: The article examines the main trends of anti-Catholic polemics in the journals of theological academies in the Russian Empire in the second half of the 19th ‒ early 20th centuries. The study aims to analyze three categories of texts (historical writings, texts addressing foreign and domestic political issues) and the inherent specifics of anti-Catholic polemics. The authors who wrote about significant events in the history of the churches tried to keep a neutral tone, with rare critical remarks embedded within historical narratives. In contrast, the articles dis-cussing contemporary foreign and domestic political affairs were far more polemical. Among external events, the reforms adopted by the Catholic Church in the second half of the 19th century were particularly debated, along with the Old Catholic movement and the figure of Pope Leo XIII. In discussions of domestic political events, particular attention was paid to the western regions of the Russian Empire. One of the key “anti-Catholic” polemical tools employed in these journals was “anti-Jesuitism”. Events that authors sought to portray in a bad light were frequently attributed to Jesuit influence. The widespread notion of “Immoral Jesuit morality” was used to criticize contemporary Catholic authors who drew upon Jesuit intellectual traditions. Through the “anti-Jesuit” lens, both the Polish Uprising of 1863‒1864 and the “Polish question” were considered.

title: The Problem of the Other and the Foreign in the European and Russian  Intellectual Tradition of the Modern Era:  Origins and Specific of Interpretation
title_original: The Problem of the Other and the Foreign in the European and Russian  Intellectual Tradition of the Modern Era:  Origins and Specific of Interpretation
summary:
The article is devoted to the study of the origins and interpretation of the problem of the Other and the Foreign in the European and Russian intellectual traditions of the Modern era. The author appeals to the sources of this question in various philosophical traditions. The problematcs of otherness, axiological reception of the Self, the Other, and the Foreign has a sustainable significance for philosophical culture, social philosophy, philosophical anthropology, and history of philosophy.
The methodological basis of the research consists of the following complementary approaches: genetic approach (G. Vico) and hermeneutic approach (H.-G. Gadamer). The analysis revealed the origins and specific features of the understanding of the Other and the Foreign in the European and Russian intellectual traditions of the Modern era. It was established that the reasoning in the European and Russian traditions witnessed the contradictions of the senses. The semantic discrepancy of the studying concepts and the geterogeneity of on-thological statutes of the Other and the Foreign in Europe and Russia of the Modern era are highlighted. It was idetified that a problem of chronological shift in Russia and the inner Other exists referring to the investigating topic. The analysis of the origins noted the absence of a common model in the reception and description of the Other and the Foreign, and non-reducibility of intellectual traditions.

title: Evolution of the Phenomenon of Artistic Creativity  in the Context of Tatar Philosophical and Aesthetic Traditions
title_original: Evolution of the Phenomenon of Artistic Creativity  in the Context of Tatar Philosophical and Aesthetic Traditions
summary:
The article explores the evolution of ideas about artistic creativity in Tatar philosophical and aesthetic thought from the Middle Ages to the early 20th century. It is established that the foundational basis for the national mod-el of creativity is the Sufi concept of the perfect human (kamil insan), within which the creative act was con-ceived as a means of divine cognition and service to a spiritual ideal. It is shown that in the age of Enlighten-ment, the secularization of aesthetic consciousness occurs: the religious dominant shifts towards social service, and creativity begins to be interpreted as an instrument of national revival and education. Special attention is given to the poetic legacy of Gabdulla Tukay, in which a synthesis of the Eastern mystical-ethical tradition, Rus-sian humanism, and European modernist influences is implemented. It is revealed that the system-forming categories of his artistic thinking are inner duty, national memory and time, understood as a condition for attain-ing immortality through the word. Based on the poetry of the early 20th century (by Dardmand and other au-thors), the author analyzes the transformation of Sufi symbolism: in the modernist discourse, the symbol loses its exclusively religious meaning and acquires epistemological and existential functions, becoming a means of cognizing being and reflecting on the meaning of life. 
The paper substantiates the thesis that the evolution of the phenomenon of artistic creativity in the Tatar tradition does not represent a linear displacement of the religious by the secular, but rather a complex process of sense generation, wherein archaic symbolic structures are preserved in a transformed state and incorpo-rated into new cultural contexts. These findings help clarify the mechanisms of interaction between Eastern and Western aesthetic paradigms in the national culture and can be used in courses on the history of Tatar litera-ture, philosophy of culture, and aesthetics.

title: The Organization of Scientific Research on the History  of Political Parties in Siberia during the Revolutions of 1917:  The Soviet Era Experience
title_original: The Organization of Scientific Research on the History  of Political Parties in Siberia during the Revolutions of 1917:  The Soviet Era Experience
summary: The main object of study in the article is scientific centers of various formats and types that explore the history of all-Russian political party organizations in Siberia during the revolutions of 1917. Based on the problem-chronological, historical-systemic method of historical cognition, the author analyzes the process of formation and development of the organization of scientific research on this issue within the framework of the Soviet state. The main subjects were Siberian “Istparts” and party archives in the pre-war period. After the war, with the formation of the Siberian section of the Scientific Council of the USSR Academy of Sciences, a unified leader-ship emerged to guide the research process of the 1917 revolutions in Siberia, and a network of university de-partments and specialized scientific institutions was established to actively study political parties. The author concludes that the established system of scientific centers has objectively contributed to achieving a high level and quality of scientific work in this field, including the defense of dissertations on the history of political parties in Siberia during the 1917 revolutions and the outbreak of the Civil War.

The main subjects were Siberian “Istparts” and party archives in the pre-war period. After the war, with the formation of the Siberian section of the Scientific Council of the USSR Academy of Sciences, a unified leader-ship emerged to guide the research process of the 1917 revolutions in Siberia, and a network of university de-partments and specialized scientific institutions was established to actively study political parties. The author concludes that the established system of scientific centers has objectively contributed to achieving a high level and quality of scientific work in this field, including the defense of dissertations on the history of political parties in Siberia during the 1917 revolutions and the outbreak of the Civil War.

title: The Bodhisattva Ideal in Theravada and Mahayana:  A Comparative Analysis of Doctrinal and Social Foundations
title_original: The Bodhisattva Ideal in Theravada and Mahayana:  A Comparative Analysis of Doctrinal and Social Foundations
summary: A comparative analysis of the doctrinal and social foundations of the bodhisattva ideal in the Buddhist traditions of Theravada and Mahayana has been conducted. The formation of the bodhisattva ideal was a natural result of the internal development of Buddhist thought. The transition from the early Buddhist path of the arhat to that of bodhisattva expands the goal of the spiritual path from individual liberation to universal enlightenment (the awakening of all beings). This reflects an understanding of the profound interconnectedness of all things, while also offering a concrete, structured practice (“paramitas”) that makes the highest philosophical abstraction ac-cessible for embodiment in personal experience. The ideal of the bodhisattva has become a philosophically grounded synthesis of absolute wisdom, which perceives the emptiness of phenomena, and boundless com-passion.                   This synthesis laid the foundation for the entire subsequent development of Mahayana, de-fining it as the “Great Vehicle”, whose aim is not merely the cessation of personal suffering, but the spiritual awakening of all living beings.              The emerging ideal did not become an alternative to the path of arhat, but rather its logical expansion and reinterpretation in the light of the doctrine of universal interconnectedness and emptiness, elevating Buddhist ethics and soteriology to a new, all‑encompassing level.
