title: Движение фронта в задаче реакция-диффузия в случае баланса реакции и диффузии
title_original: Движение фронта в задаче реакция-диффузия в случае баланса реакции и диффузии
summary: Показаны существование и единственность решения с движущимся внутренним переходным слоем в начально-краевой задаче для сингулярно возмущенного параболического уравнения реакция-диффузия в случае баланса между реакцией и диффузией. Методом пограничных функций Васильевой построено асимптотическое приближение решения вида фронта. Доказательство теоремы существования и единственности проведено с помощью асимптотического метода дифференциальных неравенств Нефедова. Полученные результаты могут быть использованы для разработки эффективных численных алгоритмов решения жестких задач, возникающих в теории нелинейной теплопроводности и популяционной динамике.

title: THE ENVIRONMENTAL MOVEMENT OF UZBEKISTAN AS AN IMPORTANT SUBJECT OF ELECTORAL LAW
title_original: THE ENVIRONMENTAL MOVEMENT OF UZBEKISTAN AS AN IMPORTANT SUBJECT OF ELECTORAL LAW
summary: This article examines the role of the Ecological Movement of Uzbekistan (transformed into the Ecological Party of Uzbekistan in 2019) in electoral law. It analyzes the legal status of the movement, its participation in electoral processes, and its contribution to the development of environmental policy. Furthermore, it discusses the opportunities for using electoral mechanisms to ensure sustainable development.

title: Украинское национальное движение как феномен интеллектуальной жизни Российской империи (конец XVIII – начало XX вЕКА)
title_original: Украинское национальное движение как феномен интеллектуальной жизни Российской империи (конец XVIII – начало XX вЕКА)
summary:
В статье предпринят анализ становления идеологии украинского национального дви-жения в контексте интеллектуальной жизни Российской империи и нациестроительства в европейском мире. Показано, что к началу XIX в. произошла этнокультурная консолидация малороссийского населения, которая позволила как изнутри, так и извне осознать «особость» этого края в Российской империи. Деятельность как малороссийских, так и великорусских интеллектуалов, прямо или косвенно участвовавших в становлении украинского национального движения, была основана на дихотомии «отдельный народ – часть русского народа». В течение большей части XIX в. это не привело к возникновению сепаратистских настроений, однако были заложены основы развития идеологии украинского национального движения в разных направлениях – как в сторону дальнейшей интеграции с Российской империей в качестве ее специфической части, так и в сторону развития сепаратистских идей и выдвижения сепаратистских требований. К концу столетия украинский национальный проект полностью сформировался как интеллектуальный продукт, но не имевший народной поддержки. Особое внимание в статье отводится роли языкового вопроса в развитии украинской этнорегиональной идентичности, который стал центральным в деятельности большинства украинофильских обществ и отдельных интеллектуалов.
                                                                                            The article analyzes the development of the ideology of the Ukrainian national movement in the context of the intellectual life of the Russian Empire and nation-building in the European world. It is shown that by the beginning of the 19th century, the ethno-cultural consolidation of the Little Russian population had taken place, which allowed both from within and from without to recognize the “specialness” of this region in the Russian Empire. The activities of both Little Russian and Great Russian intellectuals, who directly or indirectly participated in the development of the Ukrainian national movement, were based on the dichotomy of “a separate people – part of the Russian people”. During most of the 19th century, this did not lead to the emergence of separatist sentiments, but the foundations were laid for the development of the ideology of the Ukrainian national movement in different directions – both towards further integration with the Russian Empire as its specific part, and towards the development of separatist ideas and the advancement of separatist demands. By the end of the century, the Ukrainian national project had fully formed as an intellectual product, but it did not have popular support. The article pays special attention to the role of the language issue in the development of Ukrainian ethno-regional identity, which became central to the activities of most Ukrainophile societies and individual intellectuals. It is concluded that in the 19th century, external and internal, cultural and political factors overlapped, resulting in a resonant effect that gave impetus to the formation of the ideology of the Ukrainian national movement.

title: The Place of Motion Verbs within the Aspectual Class of Activity Predicates
title_original: The Place of Motion Verbs within the Aspectual Class of Activity Predicates
summary: One of the challenges in applying Zeno Vendler’s well-known aspectual classification of verbs (1957) concerns the identification of members of the class he termed activity. This class name has been translated into Bulgarian as действие and/or дейност, but it can also encompass motion verbs – particularly those denoting the spatial movement of an animate agent. This raises the non-trivial question of how to distinguish between motion verbs, action verbs, and activity verbs in a principled way, with the aim of identifying a possible “common denominator” or reference point among them. Such a reference point could justify grouping them within a single class – if this can be achieved in a non-contradictory way. The article offers a discussion intended to clarify the structure of the activity class, based on the postulate that a key to its interpretation lies in a precise analysis of the thematic group of motion verbs.

title: Лексика, выражающая движение в воде, в языке лесных юкагиров
title_original: Лексика, выражающая движение в воде, в языке лесных юкагиров
summary:
В статье рассмотрена лексика лесных юкагиров, выражающая однонаправленное и разнонаправленное движения в воде, активное и пассивное плавание; глаголы в переносном значении, передающие перемещение в воде; метафорические употребления глаголов плавания; глаголы, обозначающие течение воды. Показано, что движение в воде в языке лесных юкагиров обозначается с помощью специальных глаголов плавания, общих глаголов движения, пространственных наречий, метафорических глаголов. Течение воды передается разными глаголами, в том числе образованными от глаголов движения в воде. Анализ языкового материала позволил выявить некоторые диахронные изменения в лексике в аспекте темы исследования, уточнить происхождение и значения отдельных лексем. Описанная лексика подтверждает то, что речные системы играли огромную роль в традиционной жизнедеятельности лесных юкагиров, основанной на охоте и рыболовстве.
                  The scientific novelty of the study lies in the fact that for the first time the vocabulary representing movement in water in the Forest Yukaghirs’ language has been studied in terms of semantic and lexical-grammatical features. The aim of the study is to describe the lexical means expressing movement in water in the Forest Yukaghirs’ language and to identify their semantics. The main objectives are to select and systematize lexical units that verbalize movement in water and the flow of water; to consider the semantic and lexical-grammatical features of the identified vocabulary. The methods of continuous sampling and component analysis, contextual analysis, historical and comparative method were used. The article considers the Forest Yukaghir vocabulary expressing unidirectional and multidirectional movements, active and passive swimming; figurative verbs conveying movement in water; metaphorical uses of swimming verbs; verbs denoting the flow of water. It is shown that movement in water in the Forest Yukaghirs’ language is indicated using special verbs of swimming, general verbs of movement, spatial adverbs and metaphorical verbs. The flow of water is conveyed by various verbs, including those formed from the verbs of movement in the water. The analysis of the linguistic material made it possible to identify some diachronic changes in vocabulary in the aspect of the research topic, to clarify the origin and meanings of individual lexemes. The described vocabulary confirms that river systems played a huge role in the traditional life of the Forest Yukaghirs based on hunting and fishing.

title: THE REVERSE TRAFFIC AS A WAY TO INCREASE THE ROAD NETWORK CAPACITY
title_original: THE REVERSE TRAFFIC AS A WAY TO INCREASE THE ROAD NETWORK CAPACITY
summary: This article examines the issue of road traffic accidents in the Belgorod region, with a focus on high-traffic areas and frequent crash zones. Real accident cases and their causes are analyzed. Special attention is given to the concept of reversible traffic flow as a tool to improve road capacity and safety. The article argues that implementing reversible lanes can help reduce the number of accidents, especially during peak hours and on narrow road sections.

title: Движение частиц материала в коническом бункере
title_original: Движение частиц материала в коническом бункере
summary:
Рассмотрено движение частиц материала в коническом бункере с применением вариационного принципа для определения их траектории. Разработана математическая модель, основанная на минимизации энергии потоков частиц («линий тока»), что позволяет вычислить угловые координаты и проекции скорости частиц. После экспериментальной проверки модели возможно использование полученных результатов для того, чтобы оптимизировать организацию сплошного истечения материала из конического бункера в зависимости от конструктивных параметров последнего, например, при хранении и транспортировке цемента.
                                                                                            The movement of material particles in a conical hopper was investigated using the variational principle to determine their trajectory. A mathematical model based on minimizing the energy of particle flows  (“streamlines”) was developed, which allowed calculating the angular coordinates and velocity projections of the particles. After experimental verification of the model, it was possible to use the obtained results to optimize the organization of continuous flow of material from a conical hopper depending on the design parameters of the latter, for example, during storage and transportation of cement.

title: TURKISTONDA JADIDCHILIK HARAKATI VA TAʼLIM-TARBIYA, ADABIYOT MASALALARINING IJTIMOIY-FALSAFIY ASOSLARI
title_original: TURKISTONDA JADIDCHILIK HARAKATI VA TAʼLIM-TARBIYA, ADABIYOT MASALALARINING IJTIMOIY-FALSAFIY ASOSLARI
summary: Maqolada Turkistonda jadidchilik harakati namoyondalarining qarashlarida xalq maʼnaviy hayotini boyitish yoʻlida olib borilgan kurashlar, milliy matbuot, adabiyot va teatrning inson tafakkurini rivojlantirishdagi oʻrni haqida kuyunib asarlar yozgan, bu borada fidoyilik koʻrsatgan va natijada qatagʻon qurboniga aylangan siymolar haqida masalalari muhokama qilinadi. Ular ijodida istibdoddan qonga toʻlgan dil nolalarini va milliy ozodlikni sogʻingan qalb sadolarini eshitish mumkin kabi tushunchalar tavsiflanadi. Shuningdek, har bir inson oʻz erki bilan inson boʻlganidek, har bir davlat ham oʻzining mustaqilligi, ozodligi bilan toʻlaqonli davlatdir. Jadid bobolarimiz bunday davlatni sogʻinib yashab oʻtdilar. Zero, milliy uygʻonish deb nomlangan adabiyotning bosh gʻoyasi ham shu edi.

title: «ТАБЛИҒИ ЖАМАҒАТ» ДІНИ ҚОЗҒАЛЫСЫ ЖӘНЕ  ОНЫҢ ОРТАЛЫҚ АЗИЯДАҒЫ ЕРЕКШЕЛІКТЕРІ
title_original: «ТАБЛИҒИ ЖАМАҒАТ» ДІНИ ҚОЗҒАЛЫСЫ ЖӘНЕ  ОНЫҢ ОРТАЛЫҚ АЗИЯДАҒЫ ЕРЕКШЕЛІКТЕРІ
summary: Ғылыми мақалада тәуелсіздік жылдары Орталық Азияда тараған ислами қозғалыстардың бірі «Таблиғи жамағаттың» ерекшеліктері қарастырылған. Автор діни қозғалыстың пайда болу тарихына тоқталады, сонымен қатар, басқа ғалымдардың теориялық және эмпирикалық зерттеулеріне сүйене отырып, оның қызметі, құрылымы, негізгі идеясы мен Орталық Азия аймағына тигізетін ықпалын түсінуге тырысады.Бұл зерттеуде қырғыз зерттеушісі, PhD Эмиль Нәсрітдиновтің Таблиғи жамағат туралы жеке эмпирикалық деректеріне негізделген мақала қарастырылады. Себебі автор діни ағымның сапарларына өзі тікелей тәжірибе жүзінде қатысқан, осы арқылы біз Таблиғи жамағат қозғалысы мен өкілдерінің табиғатын қатысушының көзқарасы арқылы түсіне аламыз. Бұдан бөлек, мақалада Байрам Балшы, Махеш Ранджан Дебат, Матейс Пелкманс, Иззет Ахмет Бозбей, Шусянь Тан есімді зерттеушілердің Орталық Азиядағы Таблиғи жамағаттың орны мен қызметі, сондай-ақ қозғалыстың жергілікті саяси контекстпен қарым-қатынасы туралы жазған еңбектеріндегі тұжырымдар сарапталады. Осылайша, ғалымдардың теориялық және эмпирикалық еңбектерін талдау «Таблиғи жамағаттың» Орталық Азиядағы табиғатын екі көзқарас тарапынан айқындауға мүмкіндік береді. Бұндай тәсілдеме зерттеуде жасалған тұжырымдардың ғылыми объективтілігін арттырады.

Автор діни қозғалыстың пайда болу тарихына тоқталады, сонымен қатар, басқа ғалымдардың теориялық және эмпирикалық зерттеулеріне сүйене отырып, оның қызметі, құрылымы, негізгі идеясы мен Орталық Азия аймағына тигізетін ықпалын түсінуге тырысады.Бұл зерттеуде қырғыз зерттеушісі, PhD Эмиль Нәсрітдиновтің Таблиғи жамағат туралы жеке эмпирикалық деректеріне негізделген мақала қарастырылады. Себебі автор діни ағымның сапарларына өзі тікелей тәжірибе жүзінде қатысқан, осы арқылы біз Таблиғи жамағат қозғалысы мен өкілдерінің табиғатын қатысушының көзқарасы арқылы түсіне аламыз. Бұдан бөлек, мақалада Байрам Балшы, Махеш Ранджан Дебат, Матейс Пелкманс, Иззет Ахмет Бозбей, Шусянь Тан есімді зерттеушілердің Орталық Азиядағы Таблиғи жамағаттың орны мен қызметі, сондай-ақ қозғалыстың жергілікті саяси контекстпен қарым-қатынасы туралы жазған еңбектеріндегі тұжырымдар сарапталады. Осылайша, ғалымдардың теориялық және эмпирикалық еңбектерін талдау «Таблиғи жамағаттың» Орталық Азиядағы табиғатын екі көзқарас тарапынан айқындауға мүмкіндік береді. title: AXISIMMETRIC FLUID MOTION  IN A POROUS MEDIUM IN THE   PRESENCE OF A NON-STATIONARY EXTERNAL SOURCE OR ABSORPTION
title_original: AXISIMMETRIC FLUID MOTION  IN A POROUS MEDIUM IN THE   PRESENCE OF A NON-STATIONARY EXTERNAL SOURCE OR ABSORPTION
summary: The generalized axisymmetric model of fluid motion in a porous medium in the presence of a non-stationary external source or absorption is studied by methods of group (symmetry) analysis of differential equations. All its invariant submodels of rank 1 are studied. They are specified by invariant solutions of rank 1 of the equation of the original model. These solutions are obtained either explicitly, or their search is reduced to solving systems of ordinary differential equations of the first order. For explicit solutions at specific values of the parameters included in their expressions, graphs of the pressure distribution in the porous medium are constructed. The remaining solutions are used to study physically meaningful boundary value problems for which, at the initial moment of time, the pressure and either the rate of its change along the axis of symmetry or the radial rate of its change are specified at a fixed point of the medium. These boundary value problems are solved numerically for some specific values of the parameters included in them. Graphs of the functions determining these solutions are obtained. The conducted research is relevant in many areas of applied science and technology: filtration, soil mechanics, rock mechanics, oil field engineering, construction engineering, petroleum geology, biology and biophysics, materials science.

title: Youth and patriotism: effective communication tools through the "Movement of the  First"
title_original: Youth and patriotism: effective communication tools through the "Movement of the  First"
summary:
The article examines modern approaches to military-patriotic education of youth through the 
example of the All-Russian public-state children’s and youth movement “Movement of the First”. The 
role of digital technologies (VR/AR, mobile applications, gamification) as effective communication tools is emphasized. The history of the movement’s establishment, its symbolism, and main areas of activity are analyzed. Special attention is paid to regional practices in the Republic of Bashkortostan, including the projects «First Aid», «ProeKTOriYA», «Vysota», as well as cultural memory initiatives such as «Windows of Victory». The significant influence of socio-cultural environment and traditions on the formation of patriotic identity is noted. The advantages of using interactive formats that ensure youth engagement are highlighted. Problematic areas are identified, including digital inequality and the need to adapt content. 
Recommendations for improving communication strategies are formulated.

title: IKKINCHI MASHRUTIYAT JARAYONIDA JÖN TURKLAR HARAKATI VA RESPUBLIKA G‘OYALARINING SHAKLLANISHI
title_original: IKKINCHI MASHRUTIYAT JARAYONIDA JÖN TURKLAR HARAKATI VA RESPUBLIKA G‘OYALARINING SHAKLLANISHI
summary: Fransuz inqilobidan meros boʻlib qolgan erkinlik, tenglik va konstitutsiyachilik gʻoyalari gʻarbga xos boʻlmagan jamiyatlarga ham taʼsir koʻrsatgan va bu jamiyatlarda millatchilik harakatlarining jadallashishiga sabab boʻlgan. Usmonli imperiyasida esa ushbu gʻoyalar tarqalishi va muhokamasi, ayniqsa Ikkinchi Mashrutiyat davrida, yaʼni imperiyaning parokandalik xavfi kuchaygan bir davrda koʻzga tashlanadi. Bu davr Usmonlini saqlab qolish uchun yechimlar izlanuvchi bosqich boʻlib xizmat qilgan. “Bu davlat qanday qutqariladi?” degan savolga javob izlovchi faol kuchlarning asosiy qismini Ikkinchi Abdulhamid siyosatiga qarshi chiqqan Jön turklar tashkil etgan. Parlamentar tizim, tenglik, erkinlik va ozodlikni talab qilgan bu harakat vakillari sultonga nisbatan keskin muxolif pozitsiyani egallab, yakunda parlament tizimining qayta tiklanishiga erishganlar. Mazkur maqolada Usmonli davlatining soʻnggi davrida paydo boʻlgan Jön turklar harakatining kelib chiqishi va maqsadlari oʻrganilgan, shuningdek, ushbu harakatning eng muhim siyosiy natijasi boʻlgan Ikkinchi Mashrutiyatning eʼlon qilinishi va bu qaror ortidan yuzaga kelgan siyosiy hamda ijtimoiy jarayonlar ham tahlil qilingan.

title: Движение погруженного тела на малом заглублении в ледовых условиях
title_original: Движение погруженного тела на малом заглублении в ледовых условиях
summary:
В исследовании экспериментально на базе опытового ледового бассейна проанализировано влияние положения рубки крыловидной формы на волнообразование и характер движения модели подводного аппарата в ледовых условиях. Рубка размещалась в носовой оконечности, на мидель-шпангоуте и в корме. Модель аппарата также имела кормовое горизонтальное и вертикальное оперение. Модельный лед намораживался естественным холодом до заданной толщины. Движение моделей происходило с помощью тросовой буксировочной системы, которая в отличие от традиционных подходов к буксировке моделей погруженных тел позволяла определять изменение заглубления модели под воздействием подъемной силы при заданной скорости движения. Показано, что расположение рубки в носовой оконечности приводило к генерации изгибно-гравитационных волн наибольшей кривизны и соответственно ледоразрушающей способности. Определены параметры генерируемых изгибно-гравитационных волн. С помощью предложенного критерия ледоразрушения определена их ледоразрушающая способность. Установлена связь между величиной критерия ледоразрушения и характером разрушения льда. Увеличение площади смоченной поверхности в кормовой оконечности у модели №3 вызывало рост подъемной силы и максимальное уменьшение заглубления при 0,42<Fr<0,48 по сравнению с остальными моделями. Подобный эффект наблюдался и для угла дифферента. Стоит отметить, что положение локального максимума значения γ со смещением рубки в корму соответствовало большим значениям Fr.
                  The study experimentally analyzed the effect of the wing-shaped conning tower position on wave formation and the nature of the underwater vehicle model motion in ice conditions using an experimental ice tank. The conning tower was located at the bow end, on the midship frame, and at the stern. The vehicle model also had a stern horizontal and vertical tail. The model ice was frozen by natural cold to a specified thickness. The models were moved using a cable towing system, which, unlike traditional approaches to towing models of submerged bodies, made it possible to determine the change in the model depth under the influence of the lifting force at a given speed. It was shown that the location of the conning tower at the bow end led to the generation of flexural-gravity waves of the greatest curvature and, accordingly, ice-destroying capacity. The parameters of the generated flexural-gravity waves were determined. Using the proposed ice destruction criterion, their ice-destroying capacity was determined. A connection was established between the ice destruction criterion value and the nature of ice destruction. An increase in the wetted surface area at the aft end of model No. 3 caused an increase in the lift force and a maximum decrease in depth at 0.42<Fr<0.48 compared to other models. A similar effect was observed for the trim angle. It is worth noting that the position of the local maximum of the γ value with the shift of the wheelhouse to the aft corresponded to larger Fr values.

title: Россия и униатское движение в Антиохийской православной церкви во II половине XIX — начале XX в.
title_original: Россия и униатское движение в Антиохийской православной церкви во II половине XIX — начале XX в.
summary:
Целью представленной статьи является критический пересмотр доминирующей в отечественной историографии парадигмы, интерпретирующей российское покровительство православию на Ближнем Востоке преимущественно через призму противодействия униатскому прозелитизму католической церкви. Основная проблема унионального процесса в Антиохийском патриархате (II половина XIX — начало XX в.) рассматривается не как одномоментное следствие внешней инославной пропаганды или греческой ксенократии, а как системное отражение социокультурных, политических и экономических дисфункций внутри восточнохристианского сообщества Османской империи. В работе представлен сравнительный анализ конкретных случаев перехода православных общин в греко-католичество (и обратно) в епархиях Антиохийского патриархата (Латакия, Захле, Триполи и др.). На основе неопубликованных архивных источников, консульской документации и свидетельств российских востоковедов (архимандрита Порфирия (Успенского), А.Е. Крымского) проведена типологизация мотивов унионального движения. В качестве доминирующих факторов идентифицированы: стремление избежать османских повинностей (налог «бедел-и аскериэ»), низкая материальная обеспеченность приходского духовенства, имущественные споры, связанные с эксплуатацией вакуфных земель, и нарушения канонического права в матримониальной сфере. Значительное внимание уделено контактам с западной цивилизацией через механизм относительной депривации. Значение исследования заключается в демифологизации роли «униатской угрозы» как определяющего вектора российской ближневосточной политики. Сдвиг фокуса с экзогенных миссионерских факторов на эндогенные проблемы Антиохийского патриархата (финансовая нестабильность, неэффективность церковного управления, «текучесть» левантийской идентичности) актуализирует необходимость переоценки результативности деятельности Императорского православного палестинского общества и дипломатических усилий Российской империи в регионе.
                  The purpose of this article is to critically reassess the dominant paradigm in Russian historiography, which interprets Russian patronage of Orthodoxy in the Near East primarily through the lens of counteraction to the Uniate proselytism of the Western powers. The central problem of the Unia-related process within the Patriarchate of Antioch (second half of the 19th — early 20th century) is examined not as an instantaneous consequence of external heterodox propaganda or Greek xenocracy, but as a systemic reflection of socio-cultural, political, and economic dysfunctions within the Eastern Christian community of the Ottoman Empire. The study includes a comparative analysis of specific cases of transitions of Orthodox communities to Greek Catholicism (and back) within the dioceses of the Patriarchate of Antioch (Latakia, Zahle, Tripoli, and others). On the basis of unpublished archival sources, consular documentation, and the testimonies of Russian Orientalists (Archimandrite Porphyrius (Uspensky), A.E. Krymsky), a typology of the motives underlying the Uniate movement has been developed. The dominant factors have been identified as follows: the desire to avoid Ottoman obligations and charges (the tax bedel-i askeriye), the low material well-being of the parochial clergy, property disputes related to the exploitation of waqf lands, and violations of canonical law in the matrimonial sphere. Considerable attention is devoted to the contacts with Western civilization through the mechanism of relative deprivation. The significance of the research lies in the demythologization of the role of the «Uniate threat» as a defining vector of Russian policy in the Near East. Shifting the focus from exogenous missionary factors to the endogenous problems of the Patriarchate of Antioch (financial instability, inefficiency of ecclesiastical administration, and the «fluidity» of Levantine identity) underscores the necessity of reassessing the effectiveness of the activities of the Imperial Orthodox Palestine Society and the diplomatic efforts of the Russian Empire in the region.

В качестве доминирующих факторов идентифицированы: стремление избежать османских повинностей (налог «бедел-и аскериэ»), низкая материальная обеспеченность приходского духовенства, имущественные споры, связанные с эксплуатацией вакуфных земель, и нарушения канонического права в матримониальной сфере. Значительное внимание уделено контактам с западной цивилизацией через механизм относительной депривации. Значение исследования заключается в демифологизации роли «униатской угрозы» как определяющего вектора российской ближневосточной политики. Сдвиг фокуса с экзогенных миссионерских факторов на эндогенные проблемы Антиохийского патриархата (финансовая нестабильность, неэффективность церковного управления, «текучесть» левантийской идентичности) актуализирует необходимость переоценки результативности деятельности Императорского православного палестинского общества и дипломатических усилий Российской империи в регионе.
                  The purpose of this article is to critically reassess the dominant paradigm in Russian historiography, which interprets Russian patronage of Orthodoxy in the Near East primarily through the lens of counteraction to the Uniate proselytism of the Western powers. The central problem of the Unia-related process within the Patriarchate of Antioch (second half of the 19th — early 20th century) is examined not as an instantaneous consequence of external heterodox propaganda or Greek xenocracy, but as a systemic reflection of socio-cultural, political, and economic dysfunctions within the Eastern Christian community of the Ottoman Empire. The study includes a comparative analysis of specific cases of transitions of Orthodox communities to Greek Catholicism (and back) within the dioceses of the Patriarchate of Antioch (Latakia, Zahle, Tripoli, and others). On the basis of unpublished archival sources, consular documentation, and the testimonies of Russian Orientalists (Archimandrite Porphyrius (Uspensky), A.E. Krymsky), a typology of the motives underlying the Uniate movement has been developed. The dominant factors have been identified as follows: the desire to avoid Ottoman obligations and charges (the tax bedel-i askeriye), the low material well-being of the parochial clergy, property disputes related to the exploitation of waqf lands, and violations of canonical law in the matrimonial sphere. Considerable attention is devoted to the contacts with Western civilization through the mechanism of relative deprivation. The significance of the research lies in the demythologization of the role of the «Uniate threat» as a defining vector of Russian policy in the Near East. Shifting the focus from exogenous missionary factors to the endogenous problems of the Patriarchate of Antioch (financial instability, inefficiency of ecclesiastical administration, and the «fluidity» of Levantine identity) underscores the necessity of reassessing the effectiveness of the activities of the Imperial Orthodox Palestine Society and the diplomatic efforts of the Russian Empire in the region.

title: The concept of “word-movement” in Vsevolod Meyerhold’s biomechanical system
title_original: The concept of “word-movement” in Vsevolod Meyerhold’s biomechanical system
summary: The study aims to reconstruct the implicit concept of “word-movement” in Vsevolod Meyerhold’s biomechanical system, based on an analysis of pedagogical materials from the State Higher Directing Workshops of the 1921/22 season. The article examines the problem of the ontological status of “word-movement” within the architecture of Meyerhold’s system: whether it is an independent discipline or an organic element of biomechanics. The fundamental principles of the concept are analyzed: the dichotomy of the “machinist” (consciousness) and the “machine” (body), the primacy of volitional intention over the phonetic materialization of the word, the subordination of speech and movement to the single laws of rhythm, economy, and expediency, and the interpretation of emotional excitability as a consequence of the apparatus’s technical readiness. The article’s structure is organized according to a logic of gradually delving deeper into the subject matter. It sequentially examines: (1) the fundamental dichotomy of the “machinist” and the “machine” as the basis for understanding “word-movement”; (2) the principle of economy and expediency as applied to verbal material; (3) rhythmic organization and its connection to excitability; (4) the conceptual boundaries of biomechanics and the place of “word-movement” within the system of concentrates; and (5) the relationship to dramatic text and the nature of the stage word. The study is novel in that it is the first one to reconstruct the concept of “word-movement” as an integrative aspect of biomechanics, a linking element between the “concentrate of the word” and the “concentrate of movement”, ensuring the synthesis of verbal and plastic expressiveness. A fundamental difference has been revealed in the epistemological foundations of Meyerhold’s and Stanislavsky’s systems: “the general physical laws of pantechnics” vs. the principle of “nature”. It is established that “word-movement” represents not a mechanical combination of disparate elements, but a qualitatively new formation where the word functions as a technically organized sound action, possessing kinetic energy, temporal extension, and spatial direction. The concept overcomes the traditional dichotomy of psychological and formal approaches, offering a path to creating a holistic stage language, synthesizing the obtained data, and formulating a comprehensive characterization of the concept. The conclusion outlines prospects for further research and highlights the significance of Meyerhold’s legacy for contemporary theatre theory.

title: ВЛИЯНИЕТО НА ЖЕНИТЕ В МОНАШЕСКОТО ДВИЖЕНИЕ НА IV ВEK СПОРЕД БЛАЖ. ЙЕРОНИМ
title_original: ВЛИЯНИЕТО НА ЖЕНИТЕ В МОНАШЕСКОТО ДВИЖЕНИЕ НА IV ВEK СПОРЕД БЛАЖ. ЙЕРОНИМ
summary: Изследването разглежда ролята на християнските жени-клиентки (меценатки) в развитието на монашеското движение през IV век въз основа на писмата и дейността на св. Йероним. Авторът показва, че аристократки като св. Паула, св. Марцела и св. Мелания Старша играят решаваща роля чрез своето богатство, покровителство и духовно наставничество. Те подпомагат изграждането на манастири, поддържат литературната работа на Йероним и улесняват пренасянето на аскетизма от Рим към Витлеем и Йерусалим. Анализът подчертава взаимодействието между пол, власт и религиозна практика, като показва как елитните жени се превръщат в ключови посредници при популяризирането на „ангелския живот“ и при утвърждаването на клира в целомъдрие. Въпреки културните ограничения, тяхната подкрепа и духовен авторитет разкриват, че ранното християнско монашество е немислимо без активното участие на жените.

title: ПАРТИЗАНСКОЕ ДВИЖЕНИЕ В КАБАРДИНО-БАЛКАРИИ В 1942-1943 ГГ.: ПРОБЛЕМА ОРГАНИЗАЦИИ И ОБЕСПЕЧЕНИЯ
title_original: ПАРТИЗАНСКОЕ ДВИЖЕНИЕ В КАБАРДИНО-БАЛКАРИИ В 1942-1943 ГГ.: ПРОБЛЕМА ОРГАНИЗАЦИИ И ОБЕСПЕЧЕНИЯ
summary:
Актуальность исследования обусловлена необходимостью развития сложившихся подходов и объективного анализа вклада народов Северного Кавказа в Победу. Несмотря на обширную историографию Великой Отечественной войны, региональные аспекты партизанского сопротивления, в частности его системные проблемы, изучены фрагментарно. Научная новизна статьи заключается в проведении критического анализа на основе архивных материалов и других источников, что позволяет выявить глубинные, а не только внешние причины трудностей движения. Цель исследования – выявить и проанализировать ключевые системные проблемы в организации материально-технического обеспечения и управленческой структуры партизанского движения на территории Кабардино-Балкарии в период немецкой оккупации 1942-1943 гг. В статье применяются принципы историзма и объективности, историко-генетический, проблемно-хронологический и статистический методы. В результате исследования установлено, что партизанское движение столкнулось с комплексом проблем: запоздалое создание и слабая координация со стороны Южного штаба партизанского движения, нехватка современного вооружения и снаряжения, неравномерность продовольственного обеспечения, снижение численности отрядов, первоначальное использование отрядов не по прямому назначению. Сокращение количества отрядов и партизан было вызвано комплексом причин: мобилизацией части бойцов на фронт, а также сознательным решением руководства НКВД сократить численность отрядов. Данная мера была направлена на оптимизацию движения и повышение его управляемости в условиях нехватки снабжения. Ключевым фактором, повлиявшим на повышение эффективности, стало создание в октябре 1942 г. централизованного Объединенного отряда партизан Кабардино-Балкарии, что позволило оптимизировать ресурсы и наладить успешное взаимодействие с регулярными частями Красной армии.
                  The relevance of the study is determined by need to develop approaches and to provide an objective analysis of the North Caucasian peoples’ contribution to the Victory the Great Patriotic War. Despite the extensive historiography, regional aspects of the partisan resistance, particularly its systemic problems, have been studied fragmentarily. Scientific novelty of the paper lies in a critical analysis based on archival materials, which makes it possible to identify the deep-rooted, rather than just superficial, causes of the movement’s difficulties. The study aims at identifying and analyzing the key systemic problems in the organization of material, technical, and logistical support, as well as management structure of the partisan movement in Kabardino-Balkaria during the German occupation 1942-1943. The research is based on historicism and objectivity principles, using historical-genetic, problem-chronological, and statistical methods. It was found that the partisan movement faced a complex of problems: belated establishment and weak coordination by the Southern Staff of Partisan Movement, a shortage of modern weapons and equipment, uneven food supply, and initial misuse of detachments for non-core tasks. The movement reduction was caused by a combination of factors: mobilization of some fighters to the front and a deliberate decision by the NKVD leadership to reduce numbers. This measure was aimed at optimizing the movement and improving its manageability amid supply shortages. The key factor that improved effectiveness was creation of a centralized Unified Partisan Detachment in October 1942, which optimized resources and established successful cooperation with the regular units of the Red Army.

title: From Empire to Republic: The Young Turk Movement and Its Role in the Modernization of the Late Ottoman Empire – Assessments in Contemporary Turkish Historiography
title_original: From Empire to Republic: The Young Turk Movement and Its Role in the Modernization of the Late Ottoman Empire – Assessments in Contemporary Turkish Historiography
summary:
The transformation of the Ottoman Empire into the Turkish Republic was a complex and protracted process that unfolded over several decades. Its foundations were laid by the Young Turk movement, which emerged in the 19th century. Remaining within the ideological framework of Ottomanism, the leaders of the Young Turk Revolution envisioned the modernization of the empire through the establishment of a constitutional monarchy. Although they did not fully embrace the principles of republicanism and secularism later championed by Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, the Young Turks, through their ideas and reformist initiatives, succeeded in cultivating a generation that would ultimately establish the Turkish Republic.

The Kemalist Revolution built upon the groundwork laid by the Young Turks’ modernization efforts. Following the proclamation of the Turkish Republic on 29 October 1923, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk introduced a series of profound and far-reaching reforms over the course of approximately fifteen years, aimed at constructing a modern, secular nation-state. The radical nature of these transformations continues to spark debate and remains a source of division within Turkish society today.

This study analyzes the continuity between the reformist ideology of the Young Turks and the political transformations of the Kemalist era, with particular emphasis on the evaluations and interpretations offered in contemporary Turkish historiography. It also traces the ideological evolution of the Ottoman modernization project, culminating in the establishment of the republican model.

Keywords: Young Turk movement, reforms, Ottoman Empire, Republic of Turkey.

title: ЭКОЛОГИЧЕСКОЕ ДВИЖЕНИЕ И ПЛАНЫ КРУПНОГО ЭНЕРГЕТИЧЕСКОГО СТРОИТЕЛЬСТВА В ПРИАМУРЬЕ (КОНЕЦ 1980-Х — НАЧАЛО 2000-Х ГГ.)
title_original: ЭКОЛОГИЧЕСКОЕ ДВИЖЕНИЕ И ПЛАНЫ КРУПНОГО ЭНЕРГЕТИЧЕСКОГО СТРОИТЕЛЬСТВА В ПРИАМУРЬЕ (КОНЕЦ 1980-Х — НАЧАЛО 2000-Х ГГ.)
summary:
Статья посвящена истории становления и развития экологического движения в Ха- баровском крае в контексте противодействия планам крупного энергетического строительства в Приамурье с конца 1980‑х до начала 2000‑х гг. На основе архивных материалов и публикаций в периодической печати исследуются ключевые этапы деятель- ности общественных организаций, прежде всего «Экологической группы» и «Комитета содействия перестройке» в Комсомольске-на-Амуре, по предотвращению строительства Дальневосточной АЭС и каскада ГЭС на Амуре. Выявлены основные формы протестной ак- тивности — от сбора подписей и организации митингов до проведения независимой научной экспертизы и участия в избирательных кампаниях. Особое внимание уделено роли научного сообщества, взаимодействию городских активистов с коренными малочисленными народами, а также аргументации противников энергетических мегапроектов, включая экологические, экономические, социальные и этнокультурные аспекты. Показана трансформация движения от массовых протестов перестроечного периода к системной экспертной и просветительской работе в 1990‑е гг. Делается вывод о необходимости учёта исторического опыта и требований экологической общественности при реализации современных планов развития топливно-энергетического комплекса региона.
                  The article analyzes the formation and development of the environmental movement in the Khabarovsk Krai within the context of opposing large-scale energy development plans in the Amur region from the late 1980s to the early 2000s. Based on archival materials and periodical publications, it examines the key stages of activities by public organizations, primarily the «Environmental Group» and the «Committee for Assistance to Perestroika» in Komsomolsk-on-Amur, aimed at preventing the construction of the Far Eastern Nuclear Power Plant and a cascade of hydroelectric power stations on the Amur River. The main forms of protest activity from collecting signatures and organizing rallies to conducting independent scientific reviews and participating in election campaigns are identified. Particular attention is paid to the role of the scientific community, the interaction between urban activists and Indigenous small-numbered peoples, as well as the arguments put forth by opponents of the energy megaprojects, including environmental, economic, social, and ethno-cultural aspects. The transformation of the movement from mass protests during the Perestroika period to systematic expert and educational work in the 1990s is demonstrated. The conclusion emphasizes the necessity of considering historical experience and the demands of the environmental community when implementing modern plans for the development of the region’s fuel and energy sector.

title: Движение к христианскому единству и/или защита Русской Православной Церкви в годы гонений: деятельность митрополита Ленинградского и Новгородского Никодима (Ротова) по установлению и развитию диалога с инославными Церквами
title_original: Движение к христианскому единству и/или защита Русской Православной Церкви в годы гонений: деятельность митрополита Ленинградского и Новгородского Никодима (Ротова) по установлению и развитию диалога с инославными Церквами
summary:
Статья посвящена деятельности митрополита Ленинградского и Новгородского Никодима (Ротова), председателя Отдела внешних церковных сношений, самого влиятельного церковного деятеля своего времени по установлению диалога с инославными Церквами в период 1960–1978 гг. На основании материалов официального издания Русской Православной Церкви Московского Патриархата «Журнал Московской Патриархии», свидетельств современников и исследований историков Церкви анализируются причины, которыми руководствовался владыка, активно развивая диалог, а также средства и плоды этого диалога.
                  The article is devoted to the activities of Metropolitan Nikodim (Rotov) of Leningrad and Novgorod’s Contribution, Chairman of the Department for External Church Relations, the most influential church leader of his time in Establish Dialogue with Non-Orthodox Churches in the period 1960–1978. Based on the materials of the official publication of the Russian Orthodox Church (Moscow Patriarchate) “Journal of the Moscow Patriarchate”, testimonies of contemporaries and research by church historians, the reasons that guided the bishop in actively developing dialogue, as well as the means and fruits of this dialogue are analyzed.

title: The Social and Pedagogical Movement and the System of Normative Regulation of General Education in Russia in the Second Half of the 19th and Early 20th Centuries
title_original: The Social and Pedagogical Movement and the System of Normative Regulation of General Education in Russia in the Second Half of the 19th and Early 20th Centuries
summary:
The relationship between government and society in school education is a key issue in Russian historical and pedagogical scholarship, addressed in various ways in the historiography devoted to Russian
education.
This article aims to demonstrate the role of the socio-pedagogical movement in the modernization
of general education in post-reform Russia, establishing new values and directions for its development
ПЕДАГОГИКА 23
that largely diverged from those proclaimed by the state authorities. Particular attention is paid to the fact that, despite the
diversity of opinions on the development of school education in the country, the state authorities pursued an educational policy aimed at preserving and developing domestic pedagogical traditions, attempting, as far as possible, to take into account
the intense socio-political and cultural changes characteristic of the post-reform period in Russia. It is emphasized that, in
pursuing the development of general education, the Russian government sought to develop and implement a regulatory system that would allow for the combination of tradition and innovation in the social development of Russian society, ensure
historical continuity in the development of public education, and stabilize the avalanche-like flow of changes in general
education in Russia in the second half of the 19th and early 20th centuries.

title: The movement of multi-station workers at industrial enterprises of the Penza territory in the pre-war period (1938 – June 1941)
title_original: The movement of multi-station workers at industrial enterprises of the Penza territory in the pre-war period (1938 – June 1941)
summary: Background. The implementation of tasks for the development of the economy in the context of modern large-scale challenges requires the study of the historical experience of the activities of state bodies and public organizations to improve the manufacturability and efficiency of production. The pre-war period (1938 – June 1941) was characterized by the expansion of the country's industrial base, new enterprises were built and reconstructed, the economy was modernized, and new equipment was introduced. An important role in the implementation of the tasks of intensifying production, increasing its efficiency in the conditions of the outbreak of World War II and limited resources was played by the labor ac-tivity of the population. One of its forms was the multi-station movement. The purpose of the work is to analyze the development of this movement in the industry of the Penza territory, the methods of leadership. Materials and methods. The assigned tasks were implemented on the basis of the use of documents of the State Archive of Penza region. The methodological basis of the study is a chronological method that allows you to highlight a problem in development; statistical method, principles of historicism and scientific objectivity. Results. The activities of party, state bodies and economic organizations of the Penza region on the introduction of new approaches to the organization of labor were investigated. The multistation movement and the movement to combine professions in industry, their results are characterized. Conclusions. Socialist competition, which developed in our country in the 1930s in various forms, played a significant role in intensifying economic development. At the final stage of industrialization, the movement of multistation workers as one of the forms of the Stakhanov movement contributed to the mastery of advanced technology, rationalization of technological processes, which made it possible to significantly increase labor productivity in the context of forced economic development. The technical knowledge and qualifications of employees were improved, various forms of training and transfer of best practices were used. Despite certain difficulties and problems, the effectiveness of multi-machine work was significant.

title: Patriotic movement to collect gifts for the Red Army during the Great Patriotic War in rear country regions (Kuybyshev, Penza, and Saratov Oblasts)
title_original: Patriotic movement to collect gifts for the Red Army during the Great Patriotic War in rear country regions (Kuybyshev, Penza, and Saratov Oblasts)
summary: The Nazi Germany invasion of the Soviet Union significantly fostered patriotism among Soviet residents. While soldiers and officers fought for their motherland, the population in the rear provided them with considerable assistance. During the Great Patriotic War, Soviet citizens could express their patriotism by gathering holiday and anniversary gifts for the Red Army. This article considers the movement using some Oblasts of the Middle Volga Region as case studies. Through the synthesis of diverse newspaper sources, archival materials, and period-specific scientific studies, the author deduces that the movement in question was of great importance, especially in terms of its emotional and psychological resonance. In addition, it strengthened the connection between the frontline and the rear, increased determination in Soviet soldiers on the front line, and boosted the confidence in victory among the civilian population in the rear regions.

title: LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF THE PEOPLES OF THE CAUCASUS UNDER THE LEADERSHIP OF IMAM MANSUR IN THE CONTEXT OF NEW ARCHIVAL SOURCES
title_original: LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF THE PEOPLES OF THE CAUCASUS UNDER THE LEADERSHIP OF IMAM MANSUR IN THE CONTEXT OF NEW ARCHIVAL SOURCES
summary:
В данной публикации на основе выявленных автором новых архивных материалов, рассматривается деятельность имама Мансура, которая была нацелена на преобразование горского общества, в том числе и чеченского общества, на духовно-нравственных началах. Идеи, которые он распространял и пытался внедрить в жизнь, можно характеризовать как реформаторские. Мансур доводил свои идеи до простых мусульман, находил среди них сторонников. Но эти идеи были созвучны и с настроениями многих немусульман населяющих регион. Вместе с тем важно отметить, что в этот период Российская империя видела в нем опасность повторения крестьянских восстаний, а потому принимала все меры, чтобы подавить движение Мансура в зародыше.
                  In this publication, based on new archival materials discovered by the author, the activities of Imam Mansur are considered, which were aimed at transforming the mountain society, including the Chechen society, on spiritual and moral principles. The ideas that he spread and tried to implement in the life of the common people can be characterized as reformist. Mansur brought his ideas to ordinary Muslims, found supporters among them. But these ideas were consonant with the sentiments of many non-Muslims inhabiting the region. At the same time, it is important to note that during this period, the Russian saw in him the danger of a repeat of peasant uprisings, and therefore took all measures to suppress Mansur's movement in the bud.

title: THE POPULAR MOVEMENT LED BY IMAM MANSOUR IN THE FRAMEWORK OF THE CAUCASIAN ISLAMIC DISCOURSE
title_original: THE POPULAR MOVEMENT LED BY IMAM MANSOUR IN THE FRAMEWORK OF THE CAUCASIAN ISLAMIC DISCOURSE
summary:
В статье предпринята попытка рассмотреть движение под руководством имама Мансура в контексте общей картины мусульманского сообщества Северного Кавказа, наметить основные линии эволюции и трансформации этого сообщества, сопровождавшиеся острой идейно-политической борьбой в рамках исламского дискурса.
                  The article attempts to examine the movement led by Imam Man sur in the context of the overall picture of the Muslim community in the North Caucasus, and to outline the main lines of evolution and transfor mation of this community, which were accompanied by intense ideological and political struggle within the Islamic discourse.

title: Космический вакуум и движение объектов в нем
title_original: Космический вакуум и движение объектов в нем
summary: В основу настоящей статьи положено представление  о вакууме как материальной среде объектов, обладающих  физическими характеристиками, из которых масса имеет  решающее значение.  -Наличие у объектов вакуума массы и других физических особенностей позволяет им   вступать во взаимодействие  между собой и с окружающими вещественными объектами. В Статье представлены причины неудачи опыта Майкельсона и Морли 1887г. по обнаружению различий скорости света в двух взаимно перпендикулярных направлениях. Показано, что из факта неудачи вовсе не следует потребность в теории относительности, изобретенной А. Эйнштейном с вытекающими из нее последствиями.

title: К вопросу цифровизации и социализации: проблема или движение вперед
title_original: К вопросу цифровизации и социализации: проблема или движение вперед
summary:
в статье исследуется процесс социализации и цифровизации, нахождение граней их взаимовлияния и соприкосновения. Цель исследования — изучение эффективности социализации в зависимости от степени и уровня сформированности информационной грамотности. Актуальность данного исследования связана с тем, что современный мир сильно изменился с появлением информационных технологий. Интернет, социальные сети, мобильные приложения — все это стало неотъемлемой частью нашей жизни. Однако, когда речь заходит о молодых людях, особенно детях, использование информационных ресурсов влечет за собой ряд особенностей. Социализация — один из основных аспектов развития ребенка. Он учится взаимодействовать с другими людьми, усваивает социальные нормы и ценности. Основными методами исследования стало изучение и анализ литературы по теме исследования, по результатам сформулированы основные теоретические положения и практические рекомендации. Активно применялись методы тематической классификации и систематизации полученных результатов. За основу взят сравнительный анализ, обобщение материала и выводы по применению в практической деятельности. По итогам проведенного микроисследования сформированы рекомендации в части методического обеспечения процесса социализации, предложены разного уровня задания и упражнения, способствующие развитию критического мышления. Учитывая, что процесс социализации требует значительных усилий по уровню осознанности от самого человека, в ходе проведения исследования применялись интерактивные формы как наиболее продуктивные виды учебных занятий. Научная новизна исследования связана с разработкой методических материалов, направленных на использование тематических интерактивных заданий по формированию критического мышления. В результате проведенного исследования установлено, что процесс социализации в цифровом обществе, проходит наиболее успешно, если личность обладает основными умениями критического мышления, которое, в свою очередь, обеспечивают информационное окружение, направленное на созидательные начала развития личности и общества в целом.
                  the article explores the process of socialization and digitalization, finding the edges of their mutual influence and contact. The purpose of the study is to examine the effectiveness of socialization depending on the degree and level of information literacy. The relevance of this study is due to the fact that the modern world has changed significantly with the advent of information technology. The Internet, social media, and mobile applications have become an integral part of our lives. However, when it comes to young people, especially children, the use of information resources has its own set of challenges. Socialization is a crucial aspect of a child's development. It involves learning to interact with others and adopting social norms and values. The main research methods were the study and analysis of literature on the research topic, which resulted in the formulation of the main theoretical principles and practical recommendations. The methods of thematic classification and systematization of the obtained results were actively used. A comparative analysis, generalization of the material, and conclusions on its application in practical activities were taken as the basis. Based on the results of the conducted micro-study, recommendations were formulated in terms of methodological support for the socialization process, and tasks and exercises of various levels were proposed to promote the development of critical thinking. Given that the socialization process requires significant efforts in terms of awareness from the individual, interactive forms were used as the most productive types of educational activities during the study. The scientific novelty of the study is associated with the development of methodological materials aimed at using thematic interactive tasks to form critical thinking. As a result of the conducted research, it was established that the process of socialization in a digital society is most successful if an individual possesses the basic skills of critical thinking, which, in turn, is provided by an information environment aimed at the creative principles of personal and social development.

title: Женское движение в Казахстане и Туве в 1920–1930-е годы
title_original: Женское движение в Казахстане и Туве в 1920–1930-е годы
summary:
В статье анализируется деятельность женотделов в Казахстане и Туве в 1920–1930-е гг. Они рассматриваются как исполнители гендерной политики, проводившейся в рамках социалистического переустройства общества. На основе анализа архивных и опубликованных источников авторы изучили основные направления, содержание, особенности и противоречия  в решении «женского вопроса» в данных республиках.
Выявлено общее и особенное в гендерной политике двух республик в 1920–1930-х гг.  Основные цели,  формы и методы работы женотделов  Казахстана и Тувы были практически идентичными, так как были разработаны для республик Востока и рекомендованы Коминтерном и РКП(б). Различия  имелись в содержании деятельности женотделов и были обусловлены разными юридическими статусами, а также историческими особенностями двух республик. Так, женотделы в Казахстане действовали в 1920-х гг., период НЭПа и  вовлекали женщин в кустарные артели. Женотделы Тувы, действовавшие в 1930-х гг., когда в ТНР был взят курс на коллективизацию, участвовали в создании колхозов и госхозов.
Авторы статьи признали противоречивость и непоследовательность гендерной политики в двух республиках в 1920–1930-е гг. Вместе с тем они показали историческое значение  первых органов женской  активности в создании предпосылок для продвижения гендерного паритета в Казахстане и Туве.

title: Конкурсное движение как форма развития профессионального мастерства
title_original: Конкурсное движение как форма развития профессионального мастерства
summary:
в статье рассматривается конкурсное движение как форма развития профессионального мастерства педагога. Конкурсное движение создает мотивацию для профессионального развития педагогов, их творчества, конкурентоспособности, повышает самооценку, влияет на инновационные процессы, повышает престиж педагогической профессии. Используя конкурсное движение, педагог повышает профессионализм и компетентность. Именно конкурс является наилучшим способом поддержания и совершенствования педагогических навыков. В работе раскрываются положительные и отрицательные стороны конкурсного движения и даются рекомендации, каких ошибок необходимо избежать, используя конкурсное движение для развития профессиональных компетенций педагогов. Рассматриваются примеры применения конкурсов в педагогической деятельности.
                  this article examines competitive teaching as a means of developing teachers' professional skills. It motivates teachers' professional development, creativity, and competitiveness, enhances self-esteem, influences innovation, and enhances the prestige of the teaching profession. By using competitive teaching, teachers enhance their professionalism and competence. Competition is the best way to maintain and improve teaching skills. The article explores the positive and negative aspects of competitive teaching and offers recommendations on avoiding pitfalls when using competitive teaching to develop teachers' professional competencies. Examples of the use of competitions in teaching are also discussed.

title: Mass physical culture movement in the USSR: problems of management and organization in 1945-1953
title_original: Mass physical culture movement in the USSR: problems of management and organization in 1945-1953
summary: The article investigates the challenges of managing and organizing the mass physical culture movement in the USSR during the period from 1945 to 1953. The research aims to assess the effectiveness of state policy in physical culture and sports during the postwar years. The work examines the contradictions between ambitious government plans and actual socio-economic capabilities. Particular attention is given to the mechanisms used to achieve mass participation, including the establishment of physical culture collectives, the implementation of the GTO (Ready for Labour and Defence) complex, the organization of socialist emulation, and the ‘city patronage over the countryside’ initiative. The author thoroughly investigates propaganda campaigns and directive documents that shaped the ideological discourse on the national importance of physical culture. For the first time, the study provides a comprehensive analysis of the everyday practices of the grassroots administrative level – district sports committees – identifying systemic dysfunctions common throughout the country (staff shortages, underfunding, reporting formalism, and diversion to auxiliary tasks). The research findings indicate that the mass physical culture movement in the USSR from 1945 to 1953 remained more of a declared ideological objective than a genuinely achieved goal of state policy.

Particular attention is given to the mechanisms used to achieve mass participation, including the establishment of physical culture collectives, the implementation of the GTO (Ready for Labour and Defence) complex, the organization of socialist emulation, and the ‘city patronage over the countryside’ initiative. The author thoroughly investigates propaganda campaigns and directive documents that shaped the ideological discourse on the national importance of physical culture. For the first time, the study provides a comprehensive analysis of the everyday practices of the grassroots administrative level – district sports committees – identifying systemic dysfunctions common throughout the country (staff shortages, underfunding, reporting formalism, and diversion to auxiliary tasks). The research findings indicate that the mass physical culture movement in the USSR from 1945 to 1953 remained more of a declared ideological objective than a genuinely achieved goal of state policy.

title: ERNST NIEKISCH AND THE NATIONAL BOLSHEVIK MOVEMENT IN THE WEIMAR REPUBLIC
title_original: ERNST NIEKISCH AND THE NATIONAL BOLSHEVIK MOVEMENT IN THE WEIMAR REPUBLIC
summary: This article analyzes the development of the political movement known as National Bolshevism in the Weimar Republic. This phenomenon is examined through the prism of the political activity and intellectual legacy of Ernst Niekisch. The study of National Bolshevism as an intellectual movement is carried out through the analysis ofpublishing activities, in particular the magazine Understand, as well as the political journalism of E. Niekisch. Emphasis is placed on understanding the political platform of National Bolshevism, its domestic political model andforeign policy concept, which assumed an orientation and alliance with the USSR. A distinctive feature of Erst Niekisch’s political journalism was the desire to synthesize socialism and nationalism. This position was characteristic of many politicaljournalists of the Weimar Republic, mainly representing the right spectrum ofpolitical movements, and in intellectual terms found expression in the intellectual current of the Conservative Revolution, represented by the names of O. Spengler, A. Moeller van den Bruck and E. Junger. This article examines the distinctive features of the National Bolshevik critique of National Socialism, particularly Ernst Niekisch’s brilliant essay “Hitler - Germany’s Evil Fate,” in which he provided a profound analysis of the development of the National Socialist movement and its danger to German society. Ernst Niekisch’s consistent antiNazi stance led to his arrest in 1937 and lengthy imprisonment in Nazi prisons.

title: The Timurov youth movement in the 1940s–1960s of the 20th century
title_original: The Timurov youth movement in the 1940s–1960s of the 20th century
summary:
This article represents a historical-pedagogical study of the Timurovtsy movement in the Soviet Union during the period from the 1940s to the 1960s. The main goal of the research is to identify the specific features of organizing and functioning of this movement, as well as determining its role in developing civic awareness and patriotism among children and adolescents. The author emphasizes that the Timurovtsy movement emerged under the influence of Arkady Gaidar’s novel “Timur and His Team,” quickly spreading across the country and gaining mass popularity due to support from mass media and state structures. Special attention is given to examining the specificity of the Timurovtsy movement during wartime (1941-1945). During this period, Timurovtses played an important social role by providing assistance to families of servicemen, veterans, disabled people, and other categories of those in need. The organization was characterized by high involvement of children and teenagers, active promotion of ideas such as mutual aid and collectivism. It should be noted that the activities of Timurovtses contributed significantly to the formation of civil consciousness and a sense of responsibility for the fate of the country. 
The post-war situation is also studied when the Timurovtsy movement experienced serious crisis. Among the reasons for decline are bureaucratization of processes, lack of innovative initiatives, and decreased attractiveness of events for young people. It is emphasized that the experience of the Timurovtsy movement has great significance for modern times. Its positive traits – orientation towards public good, development of leadership qualities, fostering patriotism and culture of mutual help – can be used in creating new models of education and youth socialization. Modern volunteer practices widely spread in Russia largely continue the best traditions of the Timurovtsy movement adapted to new conditions and societal needs. The study shows that systematic analysis of successful examples of historical social initiatives is necessary for designing effective mechanisms of interaction between authorities, society, and educational institutions aimed at educating and supporting active participation of young people in public life of the country.

title: Реализация значения ‘движение вверх’ с помощью корневой согласной [r] в монгольских языках
title_original: Реализация значения ‘движение вверх’ с помощью корневой согласной [r] в монгольских языках
summary:
В статье представлен сопоставительный анализ семантических связей слов с общим корнем ur-/ür-, or-/ör- и общей семой ‘подъем, движение вверх/вперед’ в монгольских языках. Актуальность работы заключается в необходимости изучения проблем выражения в языке перцептивного опыта человека в процессе познания мира и изучения языковых единиц, отражающих физическое восприятие и осмысление языковой личностью окружающей действительности. Новизна исследования заключается в нахождении мотивирующих факторов, способствующих номинации явлений, процессов, связанных с подъемом и ростом, и в определении смежных лексических групп, в которых идентифицируются рассматриваемые общий корень и общая сема. Изучение плана выражения и плана содержания при выявлении глубинных основ словопроизводства ставит интересную цель – интерпретация акустико-артикуляционных особенностей звука как возможной мотивирующей основы при рождении смысла для выражении денотата. Целью же данной статьи является установление фонетико-семантического соответствия в монгольских словах с общим корнем ur-/ür-, в которых сонант [r] в процессе вербализации выражает физиологическое ощущение движения внутренней силы и энергии. Особенности этого сонанта явились мотивирующими для номинации ‘подъема внутренних сил’ в монгольских языках. Гипотеза о зависимости семантики от акустико-артикуляционных признаков этой согласной, символически положенной в основу номинации, позволила установить и описать ряд лексических единиц с корневым согласным [r], которые своей звукосмысловой оболочкой и содержанием взаимосвязаны и образуют некий единый семантический континуум. Материалом для исследования послужили данные монголоязычных словарей. Рассматриваются семантические связи между двумя лексическими группами слов с корневым элементом *ur-/ür- с общим значением: 1) ‘вверх’ (п.-мо. ergü- ‘поднимать (вверх)’; urγu- ‘расти’; üre ‘плод’, urma ‘вдохновение’; orgi- ‘бить ключом’; ürgü- ‘шарахаться’; orboyi- ~ örbüyi- ‘торчать’; örbis- ‘вспыхнуть’ и др.) и 2) ‘вперед’ (п.-мо. uruγši ‘вперед; на юг’; urid, uridu ‘прежде, перед’; öris- ‘опережать, предупреждать’, uruldu- ‘состязаться в беге’ и др.).
                  This article compares and analyzes the semantic connections of words with the common root elements ur-/ür-, or-/ör-, and the shared seme ‘rise, movement upward/forward’ in Mongolian languages. The relevance of this work lies in the need to study how language expresses human perceptual experience during world cognition and to examine linguistic units that reflect the physical perception and comprehension of surrounding reality by a language personality. The novelty of the study is in identifying motivating factors that contribute to the nomination of phenomena and processes associated with rise and growth, as well as in identifying several semantically related lexical-semantic groups. The aim of the study is to identify phonetic-semantic correlations in words with the common root element ur-/ür- in Mongolian languages by analyzing the acoustic-articulatory features of the sonant [r] (impact, energy, strength, impulse, movement). In the process of verbalization, this consonant acts as a sound sensory reaction to the physiological perception of the movement of internal strength and energy. These features motivated the nomination of ‘rise of internal strength’ in Mongolian languages. The hypothesis that semantics depend on the acoustic-articulatory features of this consonant, symbolically embedded as the basis of the nomination, made it possible to establish and describe a number of lexical units with the root consonant [r], which are connected by their phonetic-semantic structure and content and form a common semantic continuum. The factual material for the study is based on data from dictionaries of Written Mongolian, Khalkha-Mongolian, Buryat, and Kalmyk languages. Semantic connections between two large lexical-semantic groups of words with the root element *ur- and a common meaning are considered and justified as: 1) ‘up, rise’ (WMo. ergü- ‘to raise (up)’; urγu- ‘to grow’; üre ‘fruit’; urma ‘inspiration’; orgi- ‘to bubble up, surge’; ürgü- ‘to be frightened’; orboyi- ~ örbüyi- ‘to ruffle, stick out’; örbis- ‘to flare up’) and 2) ‘forward; before; to be first’ (WMo. uruγši ‘forward; to the south’; urid, urida ‘before, in front of’; öris- ‘to get ahead, to warn’; uruldu- ‘to compete in a race’).

title: THE USSR IS A MOVEMENT ALONG THE PATH
title_original: THE USSR IS A MOVEMENT ALONG THE PATH
summary: The article is devoted to a comparative study of the metaphor of the path, based on the material of the British and American press during the Second World War. The research material was obtained by continuous and purposeful sampling from digitized texts from the American archive Chronicling America and the British Newspaper Archive (from 09.01.1939, to 09.02.1945). The purpose of this article is a comparative analysis of digitized texts using corpus technologies. In the analyzed corpus, the author recorded 420 contexts, activating 255 American contexts (145 metaphorical units) and 265 British contexts (168 units). The activity of metaphorical units in the source sphere “PATH” revealed metaphorical images that included linguistic units of the following modes of transport: “tank”, “pullman (wagon)”, “the Russian locomotive”, “boat” and “auto”. Path metaphors in the Western press during the Second World War served as a key tool for conceptualizing the USSR’s role and actions in the international arena, assessing military- political dynamics and the situation during the war and predicting the outcome of the war and the postwar world order.

title: Взгляды протопресвитера Стефана Цанкова на экуменическое движение
title_original: Взгляды протопресвитера Стефана Цанкова на экуменическое движение
summary:
Болгарский богослов и церковный деятель протопресвитер Стефан Цанков стал одним из ведущих представителей православия в развернувшемся в XX в. экуменическом движении. В статье на основании сочинений о. Стефана Цанкова раскрывается содержание его догматических взглядов, связанных с оценкой инославных христиан, а также рассказывается об основных этапах его участия в экуменическом движении. Как ученый и церковный деятель, о. Стефан Цанков в XX в. внес большой вклад в укрепление дружественных отношений между православными и инославными, а также в проповедь православия среди западных христиан. В своих трудах он опирался прежде всего на сочинения тех русских богословов XIX–XX вв., которые были настроены на диалог с инославием. Подобно другим православным участникам экуменических мероприятий, о. Стефан Цанков свидетельствовал о том, что именно Православная Церковь является наследницей Древней Церкви и сохраняет традиции древнего христианства. Неоднозначен его подход к потенциальным способам объединения между христианами: наряду с требованиями сохранения догматической точности в вероучительных вопросах у него встречаются и допущения широких компромиссов, при которых во многих важных пунктах ради поддержания любви и единства разрешается свобода богословия в форме теологуменов. В учении о границах Церкви болгарский богослов придерживался мнения о принадлежности инославных к Телу Христову, в котором они пребывают в качестве больных и слабых членов, удаленных от ядра Церкви, но не совсем лишенных общения с нею. Соответственно, и совершенные вне канонических границ православия таинства он рассматривал как действительные и действенные для спасения инославных.
                  Bulgarian theologian and church figure Archpriest Stefan Zankov became one of the leading representatives of Orthodoxy in the ecumenical movement that unfolded in the 20th century. This article, drawing on his writings, reveals the essence of his dogmatic views related to the assessment of heterodox Christians and recounts the main stages of his participation in the ecumenical movement. As a scholar and church figure, Fr. S. Zankov made a significant contribution in the 20th century to strengthening friendly relations between Orthodox and heterodox Christians and to preaching Orthodoxy among Western Christians. In his works, he relied primarily on the writings of those Russian theologians of the 19th and 20th centuries who were committed to dialogue with heterodox Christians. Like other Orthodox participants in ecumenical events, Fr. S. Zankov testified that the Orthodox Church is the heir to the ancient Church and preserves the traditions of ancient Christianity. His approach to potential means of unification among Christians is ambiguous: alongside demands for maintaining dogmatic precision in doctrinal matters, he also allowed for broad compromises, allowing for theological freedom in the form of theologoumena in many important areas for the sake of maintaining love and unity. In his teaching on the boundaries of the Church, the Bulgarian theologian held the view that heterodox belong to the Body of Christ, where they exist as sick and weak members, removed from the core of the Church, but not entirely deprived of communion with it. Accordingly, he viewed sacraments performed outside the canonical boundaries of Orthodoxy as valid and efficacious for the salvation of heterodox.

Like other Orthodox participants in ecumenical events, Fr. S. Zankov testified that the Orthodox Church is the heir to the ancient Church and preserves the traditions of ancient Christianity. His approach to potential means of unification among Christians is ambiguous: alongside demands for maintaining dogmatic precision in doctrinal matters, he also allowed for broad compromises, allowing for theological freedom in the form of theologoumena in many important areas for the sake of maintaining love and unity. In his teaching on the boundaries of the Church, the Bulgarian theologian held the view that heterodox belong to the Body of Christ, where they exist as sick and weak members, removed from the core of the Church, but not entirely deprived of communion with it. Accordingly, he viewed sacraments performed outside the canonical boundaries of Orthodoxy as valid and efficacious for the salvation of heterodox.
