title: Методика повышения эффективности игры центральных нападающих на вбрасываниях с применением теннисных мячей
title_original: Методика повышения эффективности игры центральных нападающих на вбрасываниях с применением теннисных мячей
summary:
в современном хоккее игра на вбрасываниях оказывает значительное влияние на результативность команды. Вместе с тем в российской спортивной практике до сих пор отсутствует научно обоснованная методика повышения эффективности игры центральных нападающих на вбрасываниях. Также недостаточно разработан вопрос использования технических средств, способных повысить эффективность тренировки сенсомоторной реакции, являющейся ключевым фактором успешной борьбы за шайбу в момент ее ввода в игру. Цель исследования заключалась в разработке и апробации методики тренировки вбрасываний, включающей специальные упражнения с шайбами и теннисными мячами. Экспериментально доказано, что использование теннисных мячей в тренировке центральных нападающих способствует повышению скорости их сенсомоторного реагирования, что положительно сказывается на проценте выигранных вбрасываний. Результаты исследования показали, что внедрение комплекса специальных упражнений с теннисными мячами улучшило показатели сенсомоторной реакции и специальной координации хоккеистов на этапе спортивного совершенствования. Средний процент выигранных вбрасываний увеличился на 6,3%. Математический анализ подтвердил достоверность полученных данных. Разработанная методика может быть рекомендована для внедрения в тренировочный процесс команд молодежных хоккейных лиг.
                  in modern ice hockey, face-off performance significantly impacts team effectiveness. However, Russian sports practice still lacks a scientifically substantiated methodology for improving the face-off efficiency of centers. Furthermore, the use of technical training tools to enhance sensorimotor reaction—a key factor in successfully gaining possession of the puck at the drop—remains insufficiently explored. The aim of this study was to develop and test a face-off training methodology incorporating special exercises with pucks and tennis balls. The study demonstrated that using tennis balls in training centers increases the speed of their sensorimotor response, which positively affects their face-off win percentage. The results indicated that implementing a set of special exercises with tennis balls improved sensorimotor reaction and specific coordination metrics in hockey players at the stage of hockey improvement. The average face-off win percentage increased by 6.3%. Statistical analysis confirmed the significance of these results. The developed methodology is recommended for implementation in the training process of junior hockey teams.

title: Motives of game in A. O. Remez’s plays Happy Ending and Curse
title_original: Motives of game in A. O. Remez’s plays Happy Ending and Curse
summary:
The article is dedicated to the study of the theatrical legacy of Alexander Oskarovich Remez (1954–2001) – a Soviet and Russian
playwright, who pioneered an atypical development line of the so-called “black comedy”, where the game as a way of world perception and
understanding becomes the dominant intratextual element. The study focuses on the analysis of the plays Happy Ending (1974) and Curse (1980),
which are united by the affinity of authorial strategies (intimate setting, a small number of characters of close age categories, love conflict, motif
of dueling, the atmosphere of the 19th century, etc.). The role of the game element is determined in the works at the levels of action development,
characterization, chronotope, language, allusions, and reminiscences. In both plays, the characters engage in a game with each other, while the
author plays not only with the characters but also with the readers/viewers. In Happy Ending, Remez introduces the intrigue with real names, age,
and occupation of the “Man” and the “Woman”, deliberately breaking the boundaries and conventionality of the “fourth wall”. Special attention is paid to decorations and the musical-sound organization of the text. The dynamics of comedy and tragedy are noted. The analysis of Curse
is a logical continuation of the previous research by the authors of this article, dedicated to Remez’s plays Dramatic Poet (1975) and I... I... I...
(1978) – very interesting examples of the artistic rethinking of the destinies of great Russian writers of the 19th century. The foundation of Curse lies
in the attempt of a “dramatic study” (as defined by A. O. Remez) of Lermontov’s biography, whose work attracted the playwright. The researchers

The article is dedicated to the study of the theatrical legacy of Alexander Oskarovich Remez (1954–2001) – a Soviet and Russian
playwright, who pioneered an atypical development line of the so-called “black comedy”, where the game as a way of world perception and
understanding becomes the dominant intratextual element. The study focuses on the analysis of the plays Happy Ending (1974) and Curse (1980),
which are united by the affinity of authorial strategies (intimate setting, a small number of characters of close age categories, love conflict, motif
of dueling, the atmosphere of the 19th century, etc.). The role of the game element is determined in the works at the levels of action development,
characterization, chronotope, language, allusions, and reminiscences. In both plays, the characters engage in a game with each other, while the
author plays not only with the characters but also with the readers/viewers. In Happy Ending, Remez introduces the intrigue with real names, age,
and occupation of the “Man” and the “Woman”, deliberately breaking the boundaries and conventionality of the “fourth wall”. Special attention is paid to decorations and the musical-sound organization of the text. The dynamics of comedy and tragedy are noted. The analysis of Curse

title: Traditional games as a culturally grounded community physical activity intervention: Effects on physical literacy, social cohesion, and selected cardiometabolic outcomes
title_original: Traditional games as a culturally grounded community physical activity intervention: Effects on physical literacy, social cohesion, and selected cardiometabolic outcomes
summary:
Background and Purpose
Physical inactivity and declining community engagement remain important public health concerns among middle-aged adults. Although conventional exercise programs are widely recognized for supporting health-related outcomes, long-term adherence is often limited by low motivation, poor enjoyment, and insufficient social engagement. Traditional games represent a culturally grounded form of physical activity that integrates movement, cooperation, and emotional familiarity within community settings. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the effects of traditional games as a culturally grounded community physical activity intervention on physical literacy, social cohesion, and selected cardiometabolic outcomes among adults aged 35–55 years.
Materials and Methods
This study employed a parallel-group randomized controlled trial design involving middle-aged community adults aged 35–55 years. Following eligibility refinement procedures, 68 participants were randomly assigned to either a traditional games intervention group (n = 34) or a conventional community physical activity control group (n = 34). Both groups participated in supervised 60-minute sessions three times per week for 12 weeks with matched exercise frequency, duration, and intensity. Primary outcomes included physical literacy and social cohesion, while body mass index (BMI), blood pressure, and fasting glucose were assessed as secondary cardiometabolic outcomes. Final analyses included 64 participants. Data were analyzed using paired-sample t-tests, ANCOVA, and repeated-measures analyses with statistical significance established at p < 0.05.
Results
Participants in the traditional games group demonstrated significantly greater improvements in physical literacy and social cohesion compared with the control group following the 12-week intervention period (p < 0.05). Favorable reductions were also observed in selected cardiometabolic indicators, including BMI, systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, and fasting glucose levels. ANCOVA analyses indicated that the largest intervention effects were identified in psychosocial outcomes, particularly physical literacy and social cohesion, whereas physiological improvements were comparatively smaller. No severe adverse events were reported during the intervention period.
Conclusions
Traditional games may function as a culturally meaningful and socially engaging form of community-based physical activity associated with improvements in physical literacy and social cohesion among middle-aged adults. Although favorable cardiometabolic changes were also observed, the primary benefits of traditional games appear to relate more strongly to psychosocial engagement and sustained participation in physical activity. The findings suggest that culturally familiar and emotionally meaningful physical activity may support sustained community participation through enhanced enjoyment, social engagement, and reduced psychological barriers to exercise adherence. These findings support the potential value of culturally grounded physical activity interventions for promoting community health and social well-being.

title_original: MAKTABGACHA YOSHDAGI BOLALAR AQLIY RIVOJLANISHIDA O‘YINNING AHAMIYATI
summary: Maktabgacha yosh davri inson hayoti yo‘lidagi eng muhim bosqichlardan biridir. Bu bosqichda bolaning jismoniy, aqliy va ruhiy rivojlanishi uchun paydo bo‘ladigan imkoniyatlar va jarayonlar bir-biri bilan uzviy bog‘liq holda kechadi. Aynan shu paytda individual qobiliyatlar shakllana boshlaydi, atrof-muhit, oiladagi va jamoada bo‘ladigan ilk muloqotlarning ijobiy ta’siri natijasida dunyoqarash, xarakter va mustaqil fikrlash ko‘nikmalari rivojlanadi. Bu davrda bolalar ko‘proq o‘yin vositasida tashqi olamni o‘rganadilar, o‘zlari uchun yangi, ilgari noma’lum bo‘lgan narsalarni kashf qiladilar. O‘yin ularning tabiiy ehtiyoji bo‘lib, shu orqali hayotiy tajriba to‘pladilar, his-tuyg‘ularini boshqarishni, o‘zini va boshqalarni to‘g‘ri anglashni, atrofidagilar bilan muomala qilishni o‘rganadilar. Bolaning aqliy rivojlanishi, uni hayotga tayyorlash va jamiyatga to‘g‘ri moslashuvini ta’minlashda aynan o‘yin uzluksiz, tabiy va eng samarali vositadir.

title: Патриотизм как компонента и фактор формирования человеческого капитала молодежи: проектный подход (на примере тактической игры «Живая история»)
title_original: Патриотизм как компонента и фактор формирования человеческого капитала молодежи: проектный подход (на примере тактической игры «Живая история»)
summary:
в настоящее время экономический рост государства непосредственно связан с качеством человеческого капитала, важнейшей составляющей которого выступают ценностные ориентации и гражданская идентичность. Патриотизм перестаёт быть исключительно политической категорией, превращаясь в экономически значимый ресурс. Цель: комплексный анализ патриотизма как ресурса формирования человеческого капитала молодежи и обоснование эффективности иммерсивных технологий для воспитания патриотических ценностей. Методы: системный анализ, социологический и экономико-статистический подходы, изучение проектного опыта, анализ нормативно-правовых актов и научной литературы. Вопросы включения патриотизма в структуру человеческого капитала освещались в трудах российских учёных. Результаты: выявлена двойственная природа патриотизма; обосновано, что патриотизм, будучи разновидностью личностных качеств работника, является компонентой человеческого капитала; показано, что проект «Живая история» формирует личную связь с историей Отечества, критическое мышление и устойчивые патриотические ценности, повышая качество человеческого капитала молодежи. Вывод: предложены практические рекомендации по внедрению иммерсивных исторических проектов в систему дополнительного образования и молодежной политики.
                  currently, the economic growth of the state is directly related to the quality of human capital, the most important component of which are value orientations and civic identity. Patriotism is no longer an exclusively political category, becoming an economically significant resource. Objective: a comprehensive analysis of patriotism as a resource for the formation of youth human capital and substantiation of the effectiveness of immersive technologies for the education of patriotic values. Methods: system analysis, sociological and economic-statistical approaches, study of project experience, analysis of regulatory legal acts and scientific literature. The issues of the inclusion of patriotism in the structure of human capital have been highlighted in the works of Russian scientists. Results: the dual nature of patriotism is revealed; it is proved that patriotism, being a kind of personal qualities of an employee, is a component of human capital; It is shown that the Living History project forms a personal connection with the history of the Fatherland, critical thinking and sustainable patriotic values, increasing the quality of youth's human capital. Conclusion: practical recommendations are proposed for the implementation of immersive historical projects in the system of additional education and youth policy.

title: Methodology for improving long-distance shot accuracy in basketball players in the final seconds of a game based on comprehensive speed-strength and coordination training
title_original: Methodology for improving long-distance shot accuracy in basketball players in the final seconds of a game based on comprehensive speed-strength and coordination training
summary:
The purpose of the study is to develop and experimentally substantiate a methodology for improving the accuracy of long-range (three-point) shots by basketball players in the final seconds of the game, based on comprehensive speed-strength and coordination training.
Research methods and organization. The study was conducted in 2024–2025 within the framework of an elective physical education course at Petrozavodsk State University. The pedagogical experiment involved 24 qualified basketball players (aged 18–22 years, qualification: first category – Candidate Master of Sports). The study employed pedagogical observation, testing, a pedagogical experiment, and methods of mathematical statistics. The author's methodology is based on the principles of conjugate impact and involved performing special exercises against the background of simulated competitive fatigue (heart rate 160–180 bpm). 
Research results and conclusions. In the experimental group, the accuracy of long-range shots increased, and improvements were observed in jumping ability, hand grip strength, and coordination abilities. The developed methodology significantly enhances the noise immunity of long-range shooting technique under conditions of physical and psycho-emotional fatigue in the final seconds of the game. The comprehensive approach ensures the simultaneous development of speed-strength and coordination qualities and is recommended for implementation into the training process.

title: Investigating the influence of virtual reality (VR) on engagement and enjoyment in badminton – A comparison of VR and non-VR
title_original: Investigating the influence of virtual reality (VR) on engagement and enjoyment in badminton – A comparison of VR and non-VR
summary:
Background and purpose
The integration of virtual reality (VR) in physical education has the potential to increase students' engagement and enjoyment in sport. However, research comparing the effectiveness of virtual reality with conventional learning methods in badminton is limited. This study aims to analyse the impact of virtual reality-based learning, compared to traditional methods, on students' engagement and enjoyment in badminton.
Material and methods
This quasi-experimental study involved 56 primary school students (aged 10-12 years) who were divided into two groups: the virtual reality group (n=28), who used virtual reality simulation in badminton training, and the non-virtual reality group (n=28), who followed conventional learning. Student engagement was assessed with the sport engagement scale (SES), whereas satisfaction was evaluated through the physical activity satisfaction scale (PACES). The data analysis comprised descriptive statistics, the Shapiro-Wilk normality test, and the Mann-Whitney U test for group comparison.
Results
The research findings show that the virtual reality group exhibited a more pronounced enhancement in participation and enjoyment of the sport relative to the non-VR group (p < 0.05). Independent t-tests showed that VR had a moderate to large effect on engagement (d = 0.75) and a large effect on enjoyment (d = 0.85), which shows that VR can improve the badminton learning experience.
Conclusions
Virtual reality-based learning significantly increased students' engagement and enjoyment in badminton compared to conventional methods. These results suggest that virtual reality can be an effective tool in improving physical education, especially in schools with limited sports facilities. Further research is needed to explore the long-term impacts as well as optimal strategies in integrating virtual reality into the physical education curriculum.

Independent t-tests showed that VR had a moderate to large effect on engagement (d = 0.75) and a large effect on enjoyment (d = 0.85), which shows that VR can improve the badminton learning experience.
Conclusions
Virtual reality-based learning significantly increased students' engagement and enjoyment in badminton compared to conventional methods. These results suggest that virtual reality can be an effective tool in improving physical education, especially in schools with limited sports facilities. Further research is needed to explore the long-term impacts as well as optimal strategies in integrating virtual reality into the physical education curriculum.

title: Трудности перевода видеоигр как интерактивного текста (на примере игры «Ведьмак 3: Дикая охота»)
title_original: Трудности перевода видеоигр как интерактивного текста (на примере игры «Ведьмак 3: Дикая охота»)
summary:
в представленной статье исследуется проблема перевода видеоигр на примере “The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt” («Ведьмак 3: Дикая охота»), одной из самых известных и оцененных игр в индустрии. Основное внимание в статье уделяется анализу трудностей локализации, связанных с необходимостью перевода и унификации реалий и терминов, а также с одной из основных функций видеоигр – их интерактивностью. В статье изложены результаты сравнительно-сопоставительного анализа игровых текстов оригинала на английском языке и их перевода на русский язык. Также были использованы методы качественного анализа и контент-анализа. В ходе исследования рассмотрены стратегии перевода речи персонажей игры и способы преодоления выявленных переводческих трудностей. Статья также указывает на критические факторы, способствующие успешной локализации, такие как глубокое понимание культурных особенностей целевой аудитории, необходимость стандартизации реалий и терминов, тесное сотрудничество между переводчиками и разработчиками. Данная работа может быть полезной как для исследователей в области лингвистики и переводоведения, так и для разработчиков игр, стремящихся создать качественные и культурно адаптированные продукты для международной аудитории.
                  this article explores the problem of video game translation using the example of “The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt”, one of the most famous and appreciated games in the industry. The article focuses on the analysis of localization difficulties related to the need to translate realities, terms, their unification as well as one of the main functions of video games – their interactivity. The article presents the results of a comparative analysis of the original game texts in English and their translation into Russian. Methods of qualitative analysis and content analysis were also used. During the research, strategies for translating the speech of the game’s characters and ways to overcome the identified difficulties are considered. The article also identifies critical factors contributing to successful localization, such as a deep understanding of the cultural characteristics of the target audience, the need to standardize realities and terms, and close collaboration between translators and developers. This work can be useful both for researchers in the field of linguistics and translation studies, as well as for game developers seeking to create high-quality and culturally adapted products for an international audience.

title: Қазіргі цифрлық кеңістіктегі тілдік ойын феномені (Instagram әлеуметтік желісіндегі материалдар негізінде)
title_original: Қазіргі цифрлық кеңістіктегі тілдік ойын феномені (Instagram әлеуметтік желісіндегі материалдар негізінде)
summary:
This article examines the phenomenon of language play in the contemporary communicative space based on Kazakh-language content on Instagram. At the present stage of digital communication, language functions not only as a means of transmitting information, but also as a creative tool that produces emotional impact, attracts audience attention, and shapes the author’s personal style. In this context, language play is regarded as one of the significant components of internet discourse. The aim of the study is to identify the most common patterns of language play in social media texts, to analyze their structural, semantic, and pragmatic features, and to provide a linguistic description of their functioning in the modern communicative space.
The study includes a theoretical review of domestic and international scholarly works devoted to language play. As empirical material, the authors used Kazakh-language Instagram posts widely circulated in 2025. The linguistic data were analyzed using structural, comparative, and pragmatic methods. The findings show that language play is realized at the lexical, graphic, phonetic, and semantic levels. Its main devices include irony, hyperbole, paradox, pun, and intertextuality. It was also established that the key functions of language play are to create expressiveness, produce a comic effect, express social evaluation, and establish informal communicative closeness with the addressee.
The results demonstrate that language play in internet communication contributes significantly to the dynamic development of language, the formation of new language models, and the interpretation of digital discourse. The findings can be used in research on media linguistics, pragmalinguistics, and sociolinguistics, as well as in university teaching practice.
Keywords: language game, digital discourse, internet communication, Instagram, media linguistics, pragmatics, the Kazakh language, linguistic creativity.

title: Olympic Values As a Factor in the Development of Personal Qualities in the Educational Environment of a Medical University
title_original: Olympic Values As a Factor in the Development of Personal Qualities in the Educational Environment of a Medical University
summary: The article reveals some aspects of the popularization of Olympic values in the educational environment of a medical university based on the assessments of students enrolled in residency programs at the Rostov State Medical University of the Russian Ministry of Health. It presents the essence of the concept of “Olympic values,” as well as the results of an empirical study conducted to identify the significance of Olympic values as a relevant mainstream for the development of personal qualities in young professionals and future doctors in the context of medical education at a university. Based on the results of the empirical study, the article substantiates the undeniable importance of pedagogical work aimed at promoting the values and ideas of Olympism in medical universities as an integral part of professional training. The identified results are necessary for understanding the ways to improve the quality of medical education and enhance the level of professional competence of doctors in modern socio-cultural conditions.

title: Features of morbidity and sports injuries of Paralympic athletes at the 2024 Summer Paralympic Games in Paris
title_original: Features of morbidity and sports injuries of Paralympic athletes at the 2024 Summer Paralympic Games in Paris
summary: Objective. To identify common patterns, patterns of morbidity and risk factors for injury among Paralympic athletes in summer sports on the resultsof study morbidity and injury of Russian Paralympic athletes at the 2024 Summer Paralympic Games in Paris. Materials and methods. Collection and analysis of data from medical protocols of doctors of the Russian national teams at the 2024 Paralympic Games in Paris, analysis of domestic and foreign literary sources. Results. The registry of diseases included 37 nosologies in 28 (31 % of the total number) Paralympic athletes. Most of the diseases had an acute onset and successful resolution on the background of the treatment. The exacerbation of chronic diseases was associated with competition conditions and high levels of physical and psycho‑emotional stress. Among the diseases, there were 13 cases (35.1 %) of pathology of the musculoskeletal system, 10 cases (27 %) of infectious diseases of the upper respiratory tract, 4 cases (10.8 %) of digestive disorders, 6 cases (16.2 %) of disorders of the cardiovascular system, 3 cases (8.1%) of skin damage and 1 ear disease (2.7 %). 8 cases of sports injuries were registered: bruises — 4 cases (50 %), sprains — 3 cases (37.5 %), 1 fracture (12.5 %). In two cases, injuries led to restrictions in training activities, and in one case, to the termination of participation in competitions. Conclusions. Morbidity and injury rates among Russian Paralympic athletes at the 2024 Summer Paralympics in Paris correspond to the general pattern of morbidity and injury rates at other Paralympic Games in similar disciplines. Therapeutic, restorative and preventive measures at the stages of preparation and participation in the Games contribute to reducing potential risk and preventing morbidity and injury. The analysis carried out can help develop strategies for the prevention of morbidity and sports injuries at major international competitions such as the Paralympic Games.

title: Российско-северокорейские отношения на современном этапе и их влияние на региональную и глобальную безопасность
title_original: Российско-северокорейские отношения на современном этапе и их влияние на региональную и глобальную безопасность
summary: В 1990-е гг. российская внешняя политика, особенно в восточном направлении, испытывала очень серьезный кризис, поэтому абсолютно неслучайно сегодня мы переживаем так называемый «Поворот на Восток». И дело здесь не только в конфронтации со странами условного Запада, но и в насущной необходимости восполнить те лакуны, которые у нас образовались в первое постсоветское десятилетие. КНДР для нашей страны является традиционным партнером и союзником, и то, что мы фактически в 1990-е отвернулись от Пхеньяна, не делает нам чести. Начиная с 2001 г. наши отношения (за исключением пика международных санкций против КНДР в 2017–2018 гг.) развиваются по восходящей. И если пандемия затормозила несколько экономическое взаимодействие, то специальная военная операция придала импульс политическому и военно-стратегическому партнерству и сотрудничеству. Безусловно, отношения двух стран непосредственным образом влияют на региональную безопасность в Северо-Восточной Азии, а также становятся определенным маркером глубинных трансформаций на глобальном уровне.

title: Adapting television news for social media: Audience response patterns on the VK platform
title_original: Adapting television news for social media: Audience response patterns on the VK platform
summary: The article presents findings from the second stage of a study analyzing adapted news packages from 24-hour television channels on the VK platform. In this research, “adapted news packages” refer to captioned video materials with no voiceover narration or reporter on camera. Instead, they rely on video footage and/or soundbites, accompanied by background music, as their primary elements. Such packages are designed to be viewable without sound while retaining their informational value. The sample consists of video posts from three Russian 24-hour news channels—Rossiya 24, 360°, and Moskva 24—published during two typical weeks in April and September 2024. Quantitative content analysis served as the primary research method in both stages of the study. Audience response to the adapted news packages was analyzed by measuring views and total reactions (likes, comments, and shares), identifying the most popular content in both categories, and calculating audience engagement rates (ER). These quantitative findings were then correlated with qualitative data from the previous stage, including thematic focus, video duration, emotional tone, and narrative structure. A key conclusion is that the factors driving success for Russian audiences differ from those observed in Western studies. Specifically, a duration under one minute and an emotionally charged opening sequence are not decisive factors for attracting domestic viewers. abstract: The article presents findings from the second stage of a study analyzing adapted news packages from 24-hour television channels on the VK platform. In this research, “adapted news packages” refer to captioned video materials with no voiceover narration or reporter on camera. Instead, they rely on video footage and/or soundbites, accompanied by background music, as their primary elements. Such packages are designed to be viewable without sound while retaining their informational value. The sample consists of video posts from three Russian 24-hour news channels—Rossiya 24, 360°, and Moskva 24—published during two typical weeks in April and September 2024. Quantitative content analysis served as the primary research method in both stages of the study. Audience response to the adapted news packages was analyzed by measuring views and total reactions (likes, comments, and shares), identifying the most popular content in both categories, and calculating audience engagement rates (ER). These quantitative findings were then correlated with qualitative data from the previous stage, including thematic focus, video duration, emotional tone, and narrative structure. A key conclusion is that the factors driving success for Russian audiences differ from those observed in Western studies. Specifically, a duration under one minute and an emotionally charged opening sequence are not decisive factors for attracting domestic viewers. Instead, thematic relevance and narrative construction demonstrate a stronger correlation with audience retention. The article also outlines channel-specific patterns and identifies directions for further research.

title: Formation of a victorious athlete
title_original: Formation of a victorious athlete
summary: A distinctive feature of the Greek mentality was its agonistic character, and it was within Greek civilization that the history of world sport originated. Evidence of athletic and equestrian competitions can already be found in the Cretan–Mycenaean period, while the earliest references to organized contests appear in Homeric epics. During the polis period, regular athletic festivals were established in a number of Greek cities, most notably in Olympia; by the 7th–6th centuries BCE, these developed into the Panhellenic Games. Victory in the major Panhellenic competitions, especially the Olympic Games, conferred upon the athlete the status of a pan-Hellenic hero. Victorious athletes were awarded a sacred wreath, symbolizing divine favor, and were honored by their fellow citizens and all Greeks as national heroes. However, the path from initial participation in competitions to achieving victory was long and thorny, and an athlete’s success depended on several factors, including natural ability, the personality of the coach, and family upbringing. While the first two factors were undoubtedly decisive, family traditions – particularly among the aristocracy, which dominated athletic competitions in the Archaic period – also played an important role. The presence of one or more victors in local and/or Panhellenic games within a family had a significant influence on the upbringing of young athletes, who sought to emulate their fathers and grandfathers by continuing family sporting traditions. Pride in ancestral achievements encouraged them to maintain the status of a “sporting” family, to prove themselves worthy of their predecessors, and, in some cases, even to surpass them, as evidenced by the emergence of sporting dynasties in combat sports and athletics. In some cases, fathers may have acted as coaches for their sons. Parental ambition often contributed to successful athletic performance; although it could occasionally lead to misjudgments, it more often fostered perseverance, discipline, and a strong drive for victory.

title: Oʻzbekistonda bolalar va ayollar sportining rivojlanish tarixi: yutuqlar, institutsional islohotlar va xalqaro maydondagi natijalar
title_original: Oʻzbekistonda bolalar va ayollar sportining rivojlanish tarixi: yutuqlar, institutsional islohotlar va xalqaro maydondagi natijalar
summary: This article analyzes, based on historical sources, the formation and stages of development of children’s and women’s sports in the Republic of Uzbekistan during the years of independence, as well as the country’s achievements in the international sports arena. Particular attention is given to the participation of female athletes in the Olympic Games, the Asian Games, and world and continental championships, as well as to the scientific assessment of the significance of the three-stage sports training system for young athletes (“Umid Nihollari,” “Barkamol Avlod,” and “Universiada”). Furthermore, the achievements of women and youth in tennis, gymnastics, athletics, swimming, and Para-Asian sports are examined, and their role in the history of Uzbek sports is revealed. The findings of the study demonstrate that state policy aimed at supporting sports during the independence period became one of the principal factors contributing to the popularization of children’s and women’s sports and to Uzbekistan’s success at the international level.

title: Trust in Government and Support for AI in Public Services: Evidence from an Experiment
title_original: Trust in Government and Support for AI in Public Services: Evidence from an Experiment
summary: The increased introduction of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools in governance raises questions about the conditions under which citizens are willing to accept their implementation. This thesis particularly explores how dimensions of trust in government shape the support for AI in public services. The conducted analysis is grounded in the multidimensional understanding of trust in government. To conceptualize the notion, dimensions of perceived competence and perceived benevolence are distinguished and utilized as independent variables in the testing process. Based on this theoretical framework, the study hypothesized that both dimensions independently and positively shape the support for AI in the public sector; and the two dimensions enter a conditional relationship in such a way that when perceived benevolence is absent, the presence of perceived competence will not lead to support for AI. To empirically test these hypotheses the study employs a survey-based experimental design, structured to expose the respondents to treatments with varying information about governmental competence and benevolence. The analysis of data revealed an absence of positive associations between perceived competence and support for AI. Perceived benevolence and interaction term coefficients were found to be heading in the expected direction, even though none of the hypotheses could be considered as supported due to the insignificance of observed effects. Notably, however, the study found two control variables - general attitudes toward AI and baseline trust in government - as strong and consistent predictors of support for AI in the public sector. These insights of the study carry implications for future research and policymaking, emphasizing that trust in government should be treated as one of the key factors that influences the acceptance and successful implementation of AI-driven technology in the public service delivery.

title: INCREASING THE OBJECTIVITY OF ASSESSING UNIVERSITY STUDENTS IN THE DISCIPLINE “PHYSICAL CULTURE” USING LMS MOODLE
title_original: INCREASING THE OBJECTIVITY OF ASSESSING UNIVERSITY STUDENTS IN THE DISCIPLINE “PHYSICAL CULTURE” USING LMS MOODLE
summary: The article discusses mechanisms for optimizing remote control of university students’ theoretical knowledge in the discipline “Physical Cuture”. The main task when conducting control testing of students using distance learning systems is to find the most effective mechanisms for objective control of the quality of knowledge. According to the author’s observations, many of the test tasks offered to university students when monitoring their knowledge in the discipline “Physical Culture” are too simple for them and are completed on the first try. Research methods. Considering all the shortcomings identified when creating tests for LMS Moodle, the author carried out a number of actions aimed at creating an adapted test, the advantage of which was, among other things, expanding the bank of questions, a large number of practical and logical tasks, as well as changing the wording of test questions in order to make it more difficult for test takers to obtain information when answering through search queries via the Internet. Results. According to the results of 1st year SUAI students by taking the adapted test, in comparison with the usual, the number of subjects who successfully completed the test on the first attempt decreased by 31.61%, and according to the results of the success of the best attempt, by 8.56%. The results of students’ success in passing the adapted test at home were comparable to the results of passing a standard test in the room without the possibility of using the Internet and optimally fit into the criteria of classical test theory. Conclusion. To create test tasks that objectively assess students’ knowledge of physical culture, implemented using LMS tools, the teacher should form the structure of questions in such a way as to force students to use their entire conceptual and categorical apparatus and include logical thinking, rather than relying on bare information. Work with the test should continue at the stage of test takers in order to make the necessary corrections.

title: Совершенствование техники вращений у юных фигуристок в условиях учебно-тренировочной группы 1–2 года обучения
title_original: Совершенствование техники вращений у юных фигуристок в условиях учебно-тренировочной группы 1–2 года обучения
summary: Проведённое исследование позволило подробно проанализировать особенности процесса обучениятехнике вращений у юных фигуристок на этапе учебно-тренировочной подготовки. title: Transformation of large sports facilities after the completion of the main competitions
title_original: Transformation of large sports facilities after the completion of the main competitions
summary: The article examines the problems that hinder the construction of transformable sports facilities, and ways to maintain demand for large sports facilities in the post-Olympic period or after the completion of the competitions for which they were built – a theoretical and practical basis.

title: Assessment of mega-event impact on recognizability of host cities: the «Saransk» vs «Moscow» effects at the FIFA World Cups 2010–2018
title_original: Assessment of mega-event impact on recognizability of host cities: the «Saransk» vs «Moscow» effects at the FIFA World Cups 2010–2018
summary: This article presents a quasi-experimental evaluation of the mega-events impact on global interest in hosting cities (N = 32), using the FIFA World Cups held in South Africa, Brazil, and Russia as an empirical base. Methodologically the research is centered around the Difference-in-Differences (DiD) method, applied to Google Trends data. The choice of the Difference-in-Differences method, combined with the winsorization procedure and the FE–model, yielded statistically robust estimates. This approach proved effective for assessing mega-event’s impact on ilevel of interest towards hosting cities, overcoming the limitations of simple visual analysis. Further analysis revealed that the effect scale is influenced by the city’s population size and the higher status of the match held. The greatest increase in interest rate was observed in small cities, initially less known to an international audience (the «Saransk effect»). At the same time, the effect was less pronounced in large cities with an established global status, although cities that hosted key matches and served as logistical hubs also demonstrated a significant effect (the «Moscow effect»).

title: Второй экран как социальная архитектура параллельного потребления контента
title_original: Второй экран как социальная архитектура параллельного потребления контента
summary: Второй экран (смартфон, планшет) перестаёт быть просто техническим дополнением к основному контенту, превращаясь в самостоятельную социальную архитектуру. В рамках параллельного потребления он задаёт новые правила коллективного взаимодействия: формирует синхронные реактивные сообщества (чаты, твиттер-обсуждения), структурирует рассеянное внимание через микропаузы и создаёт экономику эмоций (лайки, стикеры, донаты). В результате зритель одновременно находится внутри двух нарративов — линейного (ТВ/стрим) и клипового (второй экран) — что меняет природу совместного просмотра с пассивного созерцания на активное соучастие без физического присутствия друг друга.

title: Health-improving physical education as a method of correcting school anxiety and psycho-emotional stress in primary school students
title_original: Health-improving physical education as a method of correcting school anxiety and psycho-emotional stress in primary school students
summary: The paper addresses the problem of school-induced anxiety and psycho-emotional stress in primary school students, the relevance of which is due to an increase in academic workload, a decrease in the level of motor activity and a growing number of children experiencing difficulties in adapting to the educational environment. It has been shown that a high level of anxiety negatively affects cognitive activity, educational motivation, emotional state and behavioral reactions of younger schoolchildren, which ultimately reduces the effectiveness of the educational process. The purpose of the article is to theoretically substantiate the use of health-improving physical education as a means of correcting schoolinduced anxiety and psycho-emotional tension. The study hypothesizes that the regular use of health-improving physical education methods can help reduce anxiety, normalize the psycho-emotional state and increase the adaptive resources of young school learners through a comprehensive effect on physiological, psychological, and social levels. The review of current Russian and international studies has identified the key mechanisms through which motor activity influences the emotional state of children. It has been established that regular physical activity helps to reduce anxiety, improve the emotional well-being, develop self-regulation skills and strengthen resistance to stressors. Thus, the expediency of including health-improving physical education in the learning process of primary schools for the prevention and correction of psycho-emotional stress is substantiated.

title: The exchange of prisoners of war as a site of ideological confrontation during the Korean war
title_original: The exchange of prisoners of war as a site of ideological confrontation during the Korean war
summary: The Korean War (25.06.1950-27.07.1953) represents a multifaceted conflict of the Cold War era, in which the national interests of the two Korean states, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) and the Republic of Korea (ROK), became intricately intertwined with the interests of major powers - the USSR, the USA, and the People's Republic of China (PRC). From the very outbreak of the war on June 25, 1950, various proposals for achieving peace and restoring the status quo were put forward at the United Nations. However, for various reasons, the war became protracted. Truce talks commenced in July 1951 and concluded only two years later with the signing of the Korean Armistice Agreement. One of the reasons for the prolonged negotiations was the disagreement between the sides regarding the exchange of prisoners of war. The aim of this study is to examine how the ideological confrontation between the sides of the military conflict (the USA and the ROK versus the DPRK, the PRC, and the USSR) influenced the negotiations on the POWs exchange and the subsequent treatment of repatriated prisoners in their home countries (on the examples of American and British POWs). As a result of the research, the author concludes that tens of thousands of POWs became object of ideological propaganda and manipulation by both the United States, commanding the UN forces, and the DPRK and the PRC. The ideological confrontation between the sides emerged as one of the primary factors of tension within the prisoner-of-war camps, threatening the lives and safety of the captives.

title: ОЦЕНКА ФИЗИЧЕСКОГО СОСТОЯНИЯ И ОБРАЗА ЖИЗНИ СТУДЕНТОВ КОЛЛЕДЖА
title_original: ОЦЕНКА ФИЗИЧЕСКОГО СОСТОЯНИЯ И ОБРАЗА ЖИЗНИ СТУДЕНТОВ КОЛЛЕДЖА
summary: Abstract. This article presents the results of a comprehensive study that included an assessment of physical health, biological age, and fitness level—all important indicators of students' physical health – as well as sociopsychological indicators and lifestyle. The findings support the need for a differentiated approach when developing preventive and physical education and wellness programs at college. Abstract: The relevance of this study stems from the importance of maintaining and improving the health of college students as a key resource for successful academic achievement, professional development, and social adaptation. During college, key healthy lifestyle habits are established, which determine the future competitiveness of graduates. The aim of this study is to study the physical health, socio-psychological status, and lifestyle factors of college students. Materials and Methods. The study involved 105 students aged 18-20 from the Department of Secondary Vocational Education at the Altai Branch of the Nizhny Novgorod State University: 35 female students majoring in Primary School Teaching (PSТ) and 70 students majoring in Fire Safety (FS) (45 males, 25 females). The study utilized questionnaires (ranking healthy lifestyle factors, physical activity assessment, self-assessment of health, prevalence of smoking and energy drink consumption), methods for assessing physical health (G.L.Apanasenko), biological age (V.P.Voitenko), physical fitness, situational and personal anxiety (Spielberg-Khanin), the SAN test, and the quality of life index. Statistical analysis was performed using the Pearson χ² test. Results. Significant intergroup differences were identified. FS students (especially males) have better physical health and fitness indicators, physical activity, and emotional stability, but are more likely to smoke (55.5% of males) and consume energy drinks (75.6%). Female PST students perform worse in physical indicators and demonstrate higher levels of personal anxiety (25.7% with a high level), but their behavior regarding unhealthy habits is more positive (28.6% smoke, vaping only). Conclusions. The data obtained substantiate the need for a differentiated approach in the development of preventive and physical education and health programs, taking into account the educational profile and gender characteristics of college students.

title: Влияние геологической культуры на трудоустройство студентов вузов
title_original: Влияние геологической культуры на трудоустройство студентов вузов
summary: в условиях оптимизации энергетической структуры Китая, продвижения экологической цивилизации и реализации стратегии сельского возрождения геологическая отрасль переходит к зеленой, интеллектуальной и многопрофильной модели развития. Это усиливает требования к профессиональной подготовке, общекультурным качествам и трудовой этике студентов геологических направлений. Цель статьи состоит в выявлении механизмов, с помощью которых геологическая культура способствует трудоустройству студентов вузов, а также в определении практических путей ее включения в университетскую подготовку и карьерное сопровождение. Методологическую основу исследования составляют анализ научной и учебно-методической литературы, анализ нормативно-отраслевых материалов и обобщение практических кейсов университетов и организаций геологической сферы. Показано, что геологическая культура влияет на трудоустройство студентов через формирование ценностных ориентиров, профессионального этоса, практических способностей и отраслевой идентичности. Обосновано, что ее интеграция в образовательные программы, практическую подготовку и систему карьерного консультирования может повысить устойчивость профессионального самоопределения студентов и их конкурентоспособность на рынке труда. Результаты исследования могут быть использованы вузами геологического профиля, службами карьерного сопровождения и отраслевыми организациями при разработке программ профессионального воспитания и содействия занятости выпускников. in the context of China's energy-structure optimization, the advancement of ecological civilization and the implementation of the rural revitalization strategy, the geological industry is moving toward a green, intelligent and diversified model of development. This transformation increases the requirements for professional training, general cultural competence and professional ethics among students majoring in geology. The purpose of the article is to identify the mechanisms through which geological culture contributes to university students' employment and to determine practical ways of integrating it into higher education and career guidance. The methodological basis of the study includes analysis of scientific and educational literature, analysis of regulatory and industry-related materials, and generalization of practical cases from universities and geological organizations. The study shows that geological culture affects students' employment by shaping value orientations, professional ethos, practical abilities and industry identity. It is argued that the integration of geological culture into educational programs, practical training and career guidance systems can strengthen students' professional self-determination and improve their competitiveness in the labor market. The results may be used by geological universities, career guidance services and industry organizations in developing programs of professional education and graduate employment support.

Обосновано, что ее интеграция в образовательные программы, практическую подготовку и систему карьерного консультирования может повысить устойчивость профессионального самоопределения студентов и их конкурентоспособность на рынке труда. Результаты исследования могут быть использованы вузами геологического профиля, службами карьерного сопровождения и отраслевыми организациями при разработке программ профессионального воспитания и содействия занятости выпускников. in the context of China's energy-structure optimization, the advancement of ecological civilization and the implementation of the rural revitalization strategy, the geological industry is moving toward a green, intelligent and diversified model of development. This transformation increases the requirements for professional training, general cultural competence and professional ethics among students majoring in geology. The purpose of the article is to identify the mechanisms through which geological culture contributes to university students' employment and to determine practical ways of integrating it into higher education and career guidance. The methodological basis of the study includes analysis of scientific and educational literature, analysis of regulatory and industry-related materials, and generalization of practical cases from universities and geological organizations. The study shows that geological culture affects students' employment by shaping value orientations, professional ethos, practical abilities and industry identity. It is argued that the integration of geological culture into educational programs, practical training and career guidance systems can strengthen students' professional self-determination and improve their competitiveness in the labor market. The results may be used by geological universities, career guidance services and industry organizations in developing programs of professional education and graduate employment support.

title: Концепт «любовь» в русской поэтической картине мира XIX-XX веков
title_original: Концепт «любовь» в русской поэтической картине мира XIX-XX веков
summary: в статье рассматриваются структура и содержание концепта «любовь» в русской языковой картине мира на материале поэзии XIX-XX веков. Исследование ведётся в рамках лингвокультурологии и когнитивной лингвистики. Методологическая база исследования включает концептуальный анализ, методы лексико-семантического описания и интерпретацию художественного текста. Статья показывает многослойную смысловую организацию концепта «любовь» в русской лингвокультуре. По «Словарю русского языка» в ядре семантической структуры располагается «чувство самоотверженной, сердечной привязанности». Периферийные элементы формируют более широкое поле культурных значений, в котором присутствуют мотивы страсти, ревности, душевной боли, предопределённости и готовности к самопожертвованию. Анализ поэтического материала выявляет устойчивые способы художественной репрезентации любовного чувства. В русской поэзии регулярно встречаются образы возвышенного и одухотворённого переживания, драматически насыщенных любовных отношений, таинственного притяжения, выходящего за пределы рационального объяснения, а также интенсивной эмоциональной и духовной сопряжённости. Подобные поэтические модели отражают не только смысловое содержание концепта «любовь», но и культурные представления о природе человеческих чувств, закрепившиеся в русской литературной традиции. Полученные результаты уточняют представления о внутренней организации эмоциональных концептов в русской языковой культуре и создают дополнительные исследовательские возможности для лингвистического и культурологического анализа художественных текстов. the article examines the structure and content of the concept “love” in the Russian linguistic worldview based on the poetry of the 19th-20th centuries. The research is conducted within the framework of linguoculturology and cognitive linguistics. The methodological basis of the study includes conceptual analysis, methods of lexical-semantic description, and interpretation of the literary text. The article demonstrates the multilayered semantic organization of the concept “love” in Russian linguoculture. According to «the dictionary of the Russian language», the core of the semantic structure contains “a feeling of selfless, heartfelt affection”. Peripheral elements form a broader field of cultural meanings, which includes motifs of passion, jealousy, emotional pain, predestination, and readiness for self-sacrifice. An analysis of the poetic material reveals consistent modes of artistic representation of love. Russian poetry regularly features images of sublime and spiritual experiences, dramatically charged love relationships, mysterious attraction that transcends rational explanation, and intense emotional and spiritual connection. Such poetic models reflect not only the semantic content of the concept of "love" but also cultural notions about the nature of human feelings entrenched in the Russian literary tradition. These results clarify understanding of the internal organization of emotional concepts in Russian linguistic culture and create additional research opportunities for the linguistic and cultural analysis of literary texts.

title: Влияние медиаконвергенции на развитие современных корпоративных СМИ
title_original: Влияние медиаконвергенции на развитие современных корпоративных СМИ
summary: статья посвящена исследованию влияния процессов медиаконвергенции на трансформацию корпоративных средств массовой информации в современных условиях. Цель исследования заключается в выявлении и систематизации ключевых характеристик медиаконвергенции применительно к корпоративному сегменту медиасистемы, а также в определении основных векторов эволюции корпоративных СМИ под воздействием конвергентных процессов. Методологическую основу работы составили анализ научной литературы по проблеме исследования, типология и периодизация. В статье рассмотрены теоретические подходы к определению понятий «медиаконвергенция» и «корпоративные СМИ» в зарубежной и отечественной научной традиции, проанализированы практические примеры функционирования современных корпоративных медиаплатформ. Результаты исследования могут найти практическое применение в деятельности редакций корпоративных массмедиа при разработке коммуникационных стратегий, выборе каналов распространения информационных материалов и адаптации материалов под потребности различных целевых аудиторий. Выводы статьи представляют интерес для специалистов в области корпоративных коммуникаций, маркетинга и медиаменеджмента, а также для исследователей, изучающих трансформацию медиасистем в цифровую эпоху. the article is devoted to the study of the impact of media convergence processes on the transformation of corporate mass media under modern conditions. The purpose of the research is to identify and systematize the key characteristics of media convergence in relation to the corporate segment of the media system, as well as to determine the main vectors of the evolution of corporate media under the influence of convergent processes. The methodological basis of the work comprises the analysis of scientific literature on the research problem, typology, and periodization. The article examines theoretical approaches to defining the concepts of "media convergence" and "corporate media" within foreign and domestic scientific traditions, and analyzes practical examples of the functioning of contemporary corporate media platforms. The results of the research may find practical application in the activities of corporate mass media editorial offices when developing communication strategies, selecting channels for the dissemination of information materials, and adapting content to the needs of various target audiences. The conclusions of the article are of interest to specialists in the field of corporate communications, marketing, and media management, as well as to researchers studying the transformation of media systems in the digital era.

title: Контекстуальные доминанты в переводах трагедии У. Шекспира «Гамлет» на узбекский язык, теоретические и практические аспекты
title_original: Контекстуальные доминанты в переводах трагедии У. Шекспира «Гамлет» на узбекский язык, теоретические и практические аспекты
summary: в статье анализируются контекстуальные доминанты в переводах трагедии У. Шекспира «Гамлет» на узбекский язык. Контекстуальные доминанты рассматриваются как культурно-стилистические единицы, несущие идейно-эстетическую нагрузку произведения и требующие приоритетного внимания при переводе. Исследование опирается на теоретические положения Дж. К. Кэтфорда, Ю.М. Лотмана, Л.Е. Пинского, а также на современные работы по когнитивной поэтике. На материале переводов М. Шайхзода и Дж. Камала выявляются основные стратегии передачи контекстуальных доминант: словарная эквивалентность, культурная адаптация и контекстуальная экспликация. Внимание уделяется анализу ключевых метафор трагедии («mind’s eye», «unweeded garden», «convocation of politic worms», «life – theatre») и способам их сохранения в узбекских переводах. В ходе исследования установлено, что при непрямом переводе (с русского языка) происходит вторичная трансформация контекстуальных доминант, тогда как прямой перевод с английского позволяет достичь большей стилистической близости к оригиналу. the article analyzes contextual dominants in translations of W. Shakespeare's tragedy "Hamlet" into Uzbek. Contextual dominants are considered cultural and stylistic units that carry the ideological and aesthetic load of a work and require priority attention in translation. The research is based on the theoretical positions of J.K. Catford, Y.M. Lotman, L.E. Pinsky, as well as on modern works on cognitive poetics. Based on the translations of M. Shaykhzoda and J. Kamal identifies the main strategies for the transmission of contextual dominants: vocabulary equivalence, cultural adaptation and contextual explication. Attention is paid to the analysis of key metaphors of the tragedy ("mind's eye", "unweeded garden", "convocation of political worms", "life as theatre") and ways to preserve them in Uzbek translations. The study find that indirect translation (from Russian) leads to secondary transformation of contextual dominants, wheares direct translation from English achives for greater stylistic proximity to the original.

title: Распространение и рецепция переводческой мысли В.Н. Комиссарова в Китае
title_original: Распространение и рецепция переводческой мысли В.Н. Комиссарова в Китае
summary: В.Н. Комиссаров – выдающийся российский лингвист и переводовед, ключевой представитель лингвистической школы советской теории перевода, чьи научные концепции начали проникать в китайское академическое пространство в конце XX века. С этого времени идеи ученого получили глубокое осмысление и апробацию в многочисленных трудах китайских исследователей. Его теоретические положения нашли широкое применение в области теории, практики и дидактики перевода, сыграв неоспоримую роль в становлении и развитии китайского переводоведения. В статье представлен исторический анализ путей трансляции и эффективности рецепции наследия В.Н. Комиссарова в Китае, а также рассматривается их влияние на формирование национальной системы переводоведческого дискурса. С позиций эстетики рецепции анализируются многомерные связи между культурным патронажем, слиянием горизонтов отправителя и получателя информации, культурными запросами и рецептивной компетенцией принимающей стороны. V.N. Komissarov was a prominent Russian linguist, translation theorist, and a key figure of the linguistic school of Soviet translation theory. His concepts began to enter the Chinese academic sphere in the late 20th century. Since then, his ideas have been deeply analyzed and validated in numerous works by Chinese scholars. His theoretical framework has been widely applied in translation theory, practice, and pedagogy, playing a vital role in the development of Chinese translation studies. This article provides a historical analysis of the transmission and reception efficiency of Komissarov’s legacy in China and examines its influence on the formation of the national translation discourse system. From the perspective of reception aesthetics, the study analyzes the multidimensional relationships between cultural patronage, the "fusion of horizons" between sender and receiver, cultural demands, and the receptive competence of the host side.

title: Создание креативной образовательной среды в процессе обучения студентов направления «Медиакоммуникации»
title_original: Создание креативной образовательной среды в процессе обучения студентов направления «Медиакоммуникации»
summary: данная статья рассматривает возможности применения технологий креативной образовательной среды в процессе обучения студентов высших учебных заведений направления «Медиакоммуникации». На основе теоретических материалов, предлагается практическое решение внедрения нетрадиционных форм обучения на практических семинарах на примере урока-интервью. Предлагается поэтапный план занятия с парной работой, в основе которого лежит технология перевернутого класса с предподготовкой студентов согласно компетенциям специалистов по связям с общественностью в различных отраслях. Для каждого представителя индустрии рассмотрены примерные аспекты, которые необходимо учесть при подготовке. В процессе занятия происходит непосредственно интервью с дальнейшей оценкой преподавателя и рефлексией. Данные технологии могут быть применены как для направления «Медиакоммникации», так и для смежных специальностей, затрагивающих предметные компетенции с аналогичным индексом. this article examines the possibilities of using creative educational environment technologies in the process of teaching students of higher educational institutions in the field of Media Communication. Based on theoretical materials, a practical solution is proposed for the introduction of non-traditional forms of education in practical seminars using the example of an interview lesson. A step-by-step lesson plan with paired work is proposed, which is based on the technology of an inverted classroom with pre-training of students according to the competencies of public relations specialists in various industries. Approximate aspects that need to be taken into account during preparation are considered for each representative of the industry. During the lesson, an interview takes place directly with a further assessment of the teacher and reflection. These technologies can be applied both to the field of "Media Communication" and to related specialties involving subject competencies with a similar index.

title: Функционально-семантические особенности высказываний, содержащих скрытое отрицание
title_original: Функционально-семантические особенности высказываний, содержащих скрытое отрицание
summary: статья посвящена функционально-семантическим особенностям высказываний со скрытым отрицанием в современном английском языке. Анализируются конструкции, не содержащие грамматических маркеров отрицания (типа not, no), но передающие значения отказа, несогласия, возражения, уклонения от ответа, уточнения, возмущения и иронии. Исследование основано на материалах из семи литературных произведений (Дж. Даррелл, Дж. Пристли, О. Уайльд, Дж. Сэлинджер, Т. Уайлдер и др.), общим объемом 869 страниц, с использованием комплексного лингвостилистического метода: сравнительного анализа, лингвистического разбора фразеологизмов, вопросов-переспросов и контент-анализа конструкций типа Why should…?. Выявлены ключевые средства выражения: вопросительные (Why should I?, Do I?), восклицательные (I like that!, Australia!) и утвердительные формы (All in good time, You’re mad), устоявшиеся формулы (It’s a long story), интонация и переспросы. Наиболее частотны возражения как реакция на просьбы, советы или утверждения. Скрытое отрицание обеспечивает тактичность, экспрессивность и коммуникативную эффективность, минимизируя конфликт в межкультурном общении. Выводы подчеркивают роль фонетических, лексико-семантических и синтаксических индикаторов в формировании прагматических функций, что актуально для развития коммуникативной компетенции в обучении английскому языку. the article examines the functional-semantic features of utterances containing implicit negation in modern English. It analyzes constructions lacking grammatical negation markers (e.g., not, no), yet conveying refusal, objection, evasion, clarification, indignation, and irony. The study draws on seven literary works (J. Durrell, J. Priestley, O. Wilde, J. Salinger, T. Wilder, etc.), totaling 869 pages, employing a comprehensive linguostylistic method: comparative analysis, linguistic dissection of phraseologisms and echo questions, and content analysis of structures like Why should…?. Key expressive means include interrogative (Why should I?, Do I?), exclamatory (I like that!, Australia!), and declarative forms (All in good time, You’re mad), idiomatic expressions (It’s a long story), intonation, and echoes. Objections prove most frequent, typically responding to requests, advice, or statements. Implicit negation enhances tactfulness, expressiveness, and communicative efficiency, softening potential conflicts in intercultural discourse. Findings highlight phonetic, lexico-semantic, and syntactic indicators shaping pragmatic functions, with implications for English language pedagogy and communicative competence.

title: Лингвистические особенности реализации стратегий вежливости и агрессии в английском и китайском языках
title_original: Лингвистические особенности реализации стратегий вежливости и агрессии в английском и китайском языках
summary: актуальность темы исследования состоит в том, что в современном мире возрастает роль межкультурной коммуникации. При этом несовпадение норм родного и иностранного языков ведет к коммуникативным неудачам и конфликтам. Цель исследования состоит в систематизации лингвистических механизмов реализации стратегий вежливости и агрессии в английском и китайском языках. В ходе проведенного исследования были решены следующие задачи: 1) систематизированы теоретические подходы к изучению вежливости и агрессии как языковых феноменов; 2) определены основные языковые средства для каждой стратегии в обоих языках; 3) установлена связь между изучаемыми языковыми средствами и культурно обусловленными прагматическими установками коммуникантов в процессе коммуникативной ситуации. В рамках работы над исследуемой темой были задействованы следующие методы: историографический и формально-логический методы анализа научной литературы, метод педагогического наблюдения. Выводы: результаты исследования указывают на фундаментальные различия в реализации стратегий вежливости и агрессии в английском и китайском языках. В частности, выявлены стратегии негативной вежливости и прямой смягченной агрессии в английском языке, в то время как китайский язык демонстрирует стратегии позитивной вежливости и контекстуально-зависимую форму вербальной агрессии. the research relevance lies in the fact that the role of intercultural communication is increasing in the modern world. At the same time, the discrepancy between the norms of the native and foreign languages leads to communicative failures and conflicts. The research goal is to systematize the linguistic mechanisms for the implementation of politeness and aggression strategies in English and Chinese. In the course of the study, the following tasks were solved: 1) theoretical approaches to the study of politeness and aggression as linguistic phenomena were systematized; 2) the main language means for each strategy in both languages are determined; 3) a connection has been established between the studied linguistic means and the culturally conditioned pragmatic attitudes of communicants in the process of a communicative situation. Within the framework of topic under study, the following methods were used: historiographical and formal-logical methods of analysis of scientific literature, the method of pedagogical observation. Conclusions: the results of the study indicate fundamental differences in the implementation of politeness and aggression strategies in English and Chinese. In particular, the strategies of negative politeness and direct mitigated aggression in English are revealed, while the Chinese language demonstrates positive politeness strategies and a context-dependent form of verbal aggression.

title: Международный опыт управления карьерным развитием профессорско-преподавательского состава университетов
title_original: Международный опыт управления карьерным развитием профессорско-преподавательского состава университетов
summary: в данной статье анализируется опыт России и США в управлении профессиональным развитием преподавательского состава университетов. В результате анализа показаны основные механизмы поддержки профессионального роста, указаны существующие проблемы, характерные для изученных образовательных систем, такие как академические нарушения, недостаточное междисциплинарное развитие, высокая рабочая нагрузка и несовершенная система поддержки. На основе анализа выделен ряд аспектов, позволяющих совершенствовать карьерное развитие профессорско-преподавательского состава университетов Китая, среди которых, оптимизация оценки научных исследований, совершенствование системы поддержки и внимания к физическому и психическому здоровью преподавателей для повышения качества высшего образования и международной конкурентоспособности. this article analyzes the experience of Russia and the United States in managing the professional development of university faculty. The analysis identifies the main mechanisms for supporting professional growth and identifies existing problems characteristic of the educational systems studied, such as academic misconduct, insufficient interdisciplinary development, heavy workloads, and inadequate support systems. Based on this analysis, several aspects have been identified that could improve the career development of faculty at Chinese universities, including streamlining research evaluation, improving the support system, and focusing on the physical and mental health of faculty to enhance the quality of higher education and international competitiveness.
